+++ b/scripts/check-windows-release.py
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Gate publication on checks tied to the exact signed Windows installer."""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+ASSET = 'SimplyPrint-at-SoC-Windows-x64-Setup.exe'
+CHECKS = ('automated_regressions', 'native_pdf_parity', 'bridge_origin_and_input_validation',
+          'windows11_install_upgrade_uninstall', 'webview_runtime_recovery',
+          'credential_restart_hello_and_forget', 'visual_keyboard_narrator_dpi',
+          'real_soc_direct_print_queue_cancel', 'real_soc_jump_print_and_enrollment_preservation',
+          'fresh_download_signature_and_launch')
+SUFFIXES = {'.go', '.sum', '.mod', '.m', '.h', '.cpp', '.js', '.mjs', '.html', '.css', '.svg', '.py', '.ps1', '.sh', '.json', '.nsi', '.manifest', '.yml', '.yaml', '.txt'}
+
+
+def source_fingerprint():
+    paths = [p for directory in ('cmd', 'internal', 'windows', 'scripts', 'tests', '.github/workflows')
+             for p in (ROOT / directory).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
+             and (p.suffix in SUFFIXES or p.name == 'CMakeLists.txt') and '__pycache__' not in p.parts]
+    paths += [ROOT / name for name in ('go.mod', 'go.sum')]
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    for path in sorted(paths):
+        digest.update(path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix().encode() + b'\0')
+        digest.update(path.read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n') + b'\0')
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def validate(record, version, artifact, commit=None, fingerprint=None):
+    issues = []
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        return ['Validation must be an object.']
+    if record.get('version') != version or record.get('platform') != 'windows' or record.get('architecture') != 'x64':
+        issues.append('Version or target does not match.')
+    if record.get('minimum_os') != 'Windows 11':
+        issues.append('Minimum OS must be Windows 11.')
+    if record.get('source_commit') != (commit or subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()):
+        issues.append('Validation does not match the source commit.')
+    if record.get('source_sha256') != (fingerprint or source_fingerprint()):
+        issues.append('Validation does not match the current source.')
+    if record.get('signed') is not True or record.get('public_ready') is not True:
+        issues.append('A signed, qualified public candidate is required.')
+    metadata = record.get('artifact', {})
+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or metadata.get('name') != ASSET or artifact.name != ASSET:
+        issues.append('The production installer filename does not match.')
+    elif not artifact.is_file() or metadata.get('sha256') != hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest():
+        issues.append('The validation record does not match the installer checksum.')
+    checks = record.get('checks', {})
+    for name in CHECKS:
+        check = checks.get(name, {}) if isinstance(checks, dict) else {}
+        if not isinstance(check, dict) or check.get('passed') is not True or not isinstance(check.get('evidence'), str) or not check['evidence'].strip():
+            issues.append('Incomplete release check: ' + name)
+    return issues
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--fingerprint', action='store_true')
+    parser.add_argument('--version', default='1.2.0')
+    parser.add_argument('--record', type=Path, default=ROOT / 'release/windows-validation.json')
+    parser.add_argument('--artifact', type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.fingerprint:
+        print(source_fingerprint())
+        sys.exit(0)
+    if not args.artifact:
+        parser.error('--artifact is required for publication validation')
+    try:
+        issues = validate(json.loads(args.record.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')), args.version, args.artifact)
+    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as error:
+        issues = ['Cannot validate the Windows release: ' + str(error)]
+    if issues:
+        raise SystemExit('Windows public release blocked:\n- ' + '\n- '.join(issues))
+    print('Windows release checks match this source and signed installer.')

+#requires -Version 7.3

+function Invoke-Checked([string]$Program, [string[]]$Arguments) {
+    & $Program @Arguments
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "$Program failed ($LASTEXITCODE)" }
+}
+function Get-Verified([string]$Url, [string]$Path, [string]$Hash) {
+    if (!(Test-Path $Path) -or (Get-FileHash $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $Hash) {
+        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Url -OutFile $Path
+    }
+    if ((Get-FileHash $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $Hash) { throw "Dependency checksum mismatch: $Path" }
+}

+Invoke-Checked "$depot/bootstrap/win_tools.bat" @()

+        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force out/Release | Out-Null

+#requires -Version 7.3
+param(
+    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][ValidatePattern('^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$')][string]$Version,
+    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Artifacts,
+    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$ValidationRecord
+)
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
+$PSNativeCommandArgumentPassing = 'Standard'
+$project = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot
+$Artifacts = (Resolve-Path $Artifacts).Path
+$ValidationRecord = (Resolve-Path $ValidationRecord).Path
+$installer = "$Artifacts/SimplyPrint-at-SoC-Windows-x64-Setup.exe"
+Push-Location $project
+try {
+    if (git status --porcelain) { throw 'Publish from the clean source commit used to build and qualify this installer.' }
+    & python scripts/check-windows-release.py --version $Version --record $ValidationRecord --artifact $installer
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows release qualification is incomplete.' }
+    $signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature $installer
+    if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid' -or !$signature.TimeStamperCertificate) { throw 'Installer signature or timestamp is invalid.' }
+    $record = Get-Content $ValidationRecord -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+    $checksum = "$($record.artifact.sha256)  SimplyPrint-at-SoC-Windows-x64-Setup.exe"
+    if ((Get-Content "$installer.sha256" -Raw).Trim() -ne $checksum) { throw 'The checksum file does not match the qualified installer.' }
+    $repository = 'ppannawitt/print-soc'
+    & gh api "repos/$repository/releases/tags/v$Version" --silent 2>$null
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { throw 'This release already exists. Do not overwrite an existing release or tag.' }
+    & gh api "repos/$repository/git/ref/tags/v$Version" --silent 2>$null
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { throw 'This tag already exists. Choose a new release version; do not reuse or overwrite tags.' }
+    $notes = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('socprint-windows-notes-' + [guid]::NewGuid() + '.md')
+    $qualified = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('socprint-windows-validation-' + [guid]::NewGuid())
+    New-Item -ItemType Directory $qualified | Out-Null
+    try {
+        # Metadata is included in the API-visible release body because GitHub's
+        # browser download redirects do not provide browser fetch CORS headers.
+        $json = ($record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 -Compress).Replace('<', '\u003c')
+        @"
+SimplyPrint @ SoC $Version for Windows 11 x64.
+
+Download the signed setup executable and run it under your Windows account. See the [Windows guide](https://github.com/ppannawitt/print-soc/blob/main/docs/WINDOWS.md).
+
+This is an independent student project, not an official NUS application. Existing macOS downloads remain available from their releases.
+
+<!-- socprint-windows-validation
+$json
+-->
+"@ | Set-Content $notes -Encoding utf8
+        Copy-Item $ValidationRecord "$qualified/release-validation-windows.json"
+        & gh release create "v$Version" --repo $repository --draft --target $record.source_commit --title "SimplyPrint @ SoC $Version for Windows" --notes-file $notes
+        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Draft release creation failed.' }
+        & gh release upload "v$Version" $installer "$installer.sha256" "$qualified/release-validation-windows.json" --repo $repository
+        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Upload failed. The release remains a draft.' }
+        $published = & gh api "repos/$repository/releases/tags/v$Version" | ConvertFrom-Json
+        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not verify draft assets. The release remains a draft.' }
+        $remote = @($published.assets | Where-Object name -eq 'SimplyPrint-at-SoC-Windows-x64-Setup.exe')
+        if ($remote.Count -ne 1 -or $remote[0].digest -ne "sha256:$($record.artifact.sha256)") { throw 'Uploaded installer digest mismatch. The release remains a draft.' }
+        foreach ($name in @('SimplyPrint-at-SoC-Windows-x64-Setup.exe.sha256', 'release-validation-windows.json')) {
+            $asset = @($published.assets | Where-Object name -eq $name)
+            $local = if ($name.EndsWith('.sha256')) { "$installer.sha256" } else { "$qualified/release-validation-windows.json" }
+            $digest = (Get-FileHash $local -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
+            if ($asset.Count -ne 1 -or $asset[0].digest -ne "sha256:$digest") { throw "Draft asset digest mismatch: $name" }
+        }
+        & gh release edit "v$Version" --repo $repository --draft=false --latest
+        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Publication failed; inspect the existing draft before retrying.' }
+    } finally { Remove-Item $notes -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item $qualified -Recurse -Force }
+} finally { Pop-Location }

+param(
+    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path,
+    [string]$CertificateThumbprint = $env:SOCPRINT_WINDOWS_SIGN_THUMBPRINT,
+    [string]$TimestampUrl = 'http://timestamp.digicert.com'
+)
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
+if (!$CertificateThumbprint -or $CertificateThumbprint -notmatch '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{40}$') { throw 'Configure a Windows code-signing certificate thumbprint before production packaging.' }
+$certificate = Get-Item "Cert:/CurrentUser/My/$CertificateThumbprint"
+if (!$certificate.HasPrivateKey -or $certificate.NotAfter -le (Get-Date)) { throw 'The signing identity is unavailable or expired.' }
+$signTool = (Get-Command signtool.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
+& $signTool sign /sha1 $CertificateThumbprint /s My /fd SHA256 /tr $TimestampUrl /td SHA256 $Path
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Authenticode signing failed: $Path" }
+& $signTool verify /pa /all $Path
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Authenticode verification failed: $Path" }
+$signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature $Path
+if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid' -or !$signature.TimeStamperCertificate -or $signature.SignerCertificate.Thumbprint -ne $CertificateThumbprint) { throw "The signed file has an invalid identity or timestamp: $Path" }

+#requires -Version 7.3
+param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Installer)
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
+$Installer = (Resolve-Path $Installer).Path
+function Run-Bounded([string]$File, [string[]]$Arguments, [int]$Seconds = 90) {
+    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $File -ArgumentList $Arguments -PassThru
+    if (!$process.WaitForExit($Seconds * 1000)) {
+        Stop-Process -Id $process.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+        throw "Timed out: $File"
+    }
+    $process.Refresh()
+    if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "$File exited with $($process.ExitCode)" }
+}
+# Use this script only on a disposable Windows runner: installation uses its account.
+$work = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('socprint-install-test-' + [guid]::NewGuid())
+New-Item -ItemType Directory $work | Out-Null
+$previousConfig = $env:SOCPRINT_CONFIG_DIR
+try {
+    $bootstrapper = "$work/WebView2Bootstrapper.exe"
+    Invoke-WebRequest 'https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkId=2124703' -OutFile $bootstrapper
+    $signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature $bootstrapper
+    if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid' -or $signature.SignerCertificate.Subject -notmatch 'O=Microsoft Corporation(?:,|$)') { throw 'WebView2 bootstrapper signature is invalid.' }
+    # Existing runtimes may return an already-installed code; the app launch below
+    # independently verifies the runtime actually loads and completes its bridge.
+    $runtime = Start-Process $bootstrapper -ArgumentList '/silent','/install' -PassThru
+    if (!$runtime.WaitForExit(180000)) {
+        Stop-Process -Id $runtime.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+        throw 'WebView2 installation timed out.'
+    }
+    $env:SOCPRINT_CONFIG_DIR = "$work/account"
+    Run-Bounded $Installer @('/S')
+    $installed = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/SimplyPrint-SoC"
+    foreach ($name in @('SimplyPrint.exe','socprint-native.dll','Uninstall.exe','Third-Party-Notices.txt')) {
+        if (!(Test-Path "$installed/$name")) { throw "Installer omitted $name" }
+    }
+    # The host exits successfully only after app.js initializes through the
+    # trusted HTTPS origin and the native/Go JSON bridge. No terms are accepted.
+    Run-Bounded "$installed/SimplyPrint.exe" @('--smoke-test') 65
+    $marker = "$env:SOCPRINT_CONFIG_DIR/upgrade-preservation.txt"
+    'Preserve app data across setup and default uninstall.' | Set-Content $marker
+    Run-Bounded $Installer @('/S')
+    if (!(Test-Path $marker)) { throw 'Upgrade removed app data.' }
+    Run-Bounded "$installed/SimplyPrint.exe" @('--smoke-test') 65
+    Run-Bounded "$installed/Uninstall.exe" @('/S')
+    $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(15)
+    while ((Test-Path "$installed/SimplyPrint.exe") -and [DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }
+    if (Test-Path "$installed/SimplyPrint.exe") { throw 'Uninstall left the application executable.' }
+    if (!(Test-Path $marker)) { throw 'Default uninstall removed account data.' }
+    Write-Host 'Windows installation, launch/bridge, upgrade, restart and default uninstall smoke checks passed.'
+} finally {
+    $env:SOCPRINT_CONFIG_DIR = $previousConfig
+    Remove-Item $work -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Generate license notices for the Windows Go launcher dependency graph."""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+raw = subprocess.check_output(['go', 'list', '-deps', '-json', './cmd/socprint-windows'], text=True)
+decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
+modules = {}
+while raw.strip():
+    package, end = decoder.raw_decode(raw.lstrip())
+    module = package.get('Module')
+    if module and not module.get('Main'):
+        modules[module['Path']] = module
+    raw = raw.lstrip()[end:]
+parts = ['SimplyPrint @ SoC — Windows third-party notices\n', Path('LICENSE').read_text(), Path(subprocess.check_output(['go', 'env', 'GOROOT'], text=True).strip(), 'LICENSE').read_text()]
+for name, module in sorted(modules.items()):
+    directory = Path(module['Dir'])
+    paths = sorted({*directory.glob('LICENSE*'), *directory.glob('COPYING*'), *directory.glob('NOTICE*')})
+    if not paths:
+        raise SystemExit('Missing dependency license: ' + name)
+    parts.append('\n' + name + ' ' + module.get('Version', '') + '\n')
+    parts.extend(path.read_text(errors='replace') for path in paths if path.is_file())
+Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text('\n'.join(parts), encoding='utf-8')
diff --git a/scripts/windows-notices.py b/scripts/windows-notices.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..42751b0

+++ b/scripts/windows-notices.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Collect notices from the exact PDFium source checkout and its dependencies."""
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+root, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
+parts = ['PDFium and bundled dependency notices\n']
+for directory, folders, names in os.walk(root):
+    folders[:] = sorted(name for name in folders if name not in {'.git', 'out', '.cipd', '__pycache__', 'node_modules'})
+    for name in sorted(names):
+        if not name.upper().startswith(('LICENSE', 'LICENCE', 'COPYING', 'NOTICE', 'COPYRIGHT')):
+            continue
+        path = Path(directory, name)
+        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        parts.append(f'\n--- {path.relative_to(root)} ---\n{path.read_text(errors="replace")}\n')
+if len(parts) < 2:
+    raise SystemExit('PDFium notices were not found')
+output.write_text('\n'.join(parts), encoding='utf-8')

+#include "../windows/native/model.h"
+#include <iostream>
+using namespace sp;
+void check(bool ok) {
+  if (!ok)
+    throw std::runtime_error("test assertion failed");
+}
+template <typename F> void rejects(F fn) {
+  bool failed = false;
+  try {
+    fn();
+  } catch (...) {
+    failed = true;
+  }
+  check(failed);
+}
+int main() {
+  try {
+    check(trustedDocument(L"https://socprint.invalid/index.html"));
+    for (auto url : {L"http://socprint.invalid/index.html",
+                     L"https://socprint.invalid/index.html?x=1",
+                     L"https://socprint.invalid/index.html#x",
+                     L"https://evil.invalid/index.html",
+                     L"https://socprint.invalid@evil.invalid/index.html",
+                     L"file:///index.html"})
+      check(!trustedDocument(url));
+    json o = {{"Paper", "A4"},      {"Orientation", "portrait"},
+              {"ScaleMode", "fit"}, {"ScalePercent", 100},
+              {"Copies", 1},        {"PagesPerSheet", 1},
+              {"PageRange", ""},    {"AutoRotate", true}};
+    check(pages("1-3, 5, 2", 7) == std::vector<int>({0, 1, 2, 4, 1}));
+    for (auto value :
+         {"0", "8", "4-2", "1,,3", "1,", "abc", "184467440737095516160"})
+      rejects([&] { pages(value, 7); });
+    for (int n : {1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 16})
+      for (auto orientation : {"portrait", "landscape"}) {
+        auto opts = o;
+        opts["PagesPerSheet"] = n;
+        opts["Orientation"] = orientation;
+        auto grid = layout(opts);
+        check(grid.cells.size() == static_cast<size_t>(n));
+        for (auto &cell : grid.cells)
+          check(cell.x >= 18 && cell.y >= 17.999 &&
+                cell.x + cell.w <= grid.width - 17.999 &&
+                cell.y + cell.h <= grid.height - 17.999);
+      }
+    for (auto value : {0, 100}) {
+      auto bad = o;
+      bad["Copies"] = value;
+      rejects([&] { options(bad); });
+    }
+    for (auto field : {"Copies", "PagesPerSheet"}) {
+      auto bad = o;
+      bad[field] = uint64_t(4294967297);
+      rejects([&] { options(bad); });
+    }
+    for (auto field : {"Copies", "ScalePercent", "PagesPerSheet"}) {
+      auto bad = o;
+      bad[field] = true;
+      rejects([&] { options(bad); });
+    }
+    auto bad = o;
+    bad["PagesPerSheet"] = 3;
+    rejects([&] { options(bad); });
+    bad = o;
+    bad["Extra"] = 1;
+    rejects([&] { options(bad); });
+    request({{"ID", "1"},
+             {"Action", "preparePDF"},
+             {"DocumentHandle", "doc"},
+             {"Username", "student"},
+             {"PrinterID", "printer"},
+             {"Queue", "queue"},
+             {"Options", o}});
+    rejects([&] {
+      request({{"ID", "1"},
+               {"Action", "submitPrint"},
+               {"FilePath", "C:\\private.pdf"}});
+    });
+    rejects([&] {
+      request({{"ID", "1"},
+               {"Action", "submitPrint"},
+               {"PreparedHandle", "p"},
+               {"Username", "other"}});
+    });
+    rejects([&] {
+      request({{"ID", "1"},
+               {"Action", "preparePDF"},
+               {"DocumentHandle", "d"},
+               {"Options", o}});
+    });
+    rejects([&] {
+      request({{"ID", "1"}, {"Action", "initialize"}, {"Forget", 1}});
+    });
+    rejects([&] { request({{"ID", "1"}, {"Action", "unknown"}}); });
+    check(failure({{"ID", 42}}, "invalidRequest", "bad")["ID"] == "");
+    std::cout << "Windows request validation and layout checks passed\n";
+    return 0;
+  } catch (const std::exception &e) {
+    std::cerr << e.what() << '\n';
+    return 1;
+  }
+}

+#include "../windows/native/pdf.h"
+#include "fpdf_annot.h"
+#include "fpdf_edit.h"
+#include "fpdf_save.h"
+#include "fpdf_text.h"
+#include "fpdf_transformpage.h"
+#include <fstream>
+#include <iostream>
+#include <winrt/base.h>
+using namespace sp;
+namespace fs = std::filesystem;
+static void check(bool ok, const char *message) {
+  if (!ok)
+    throw std::runtime_error(message);
+}
+template <typename F> static void rejects(F fn) {
+  bool failed = false;
+  try {
+    fn();
+  } catch (...) {
+    failed = true;
+  }
+  check(failed, "Expected rejection");
+}
+struct Save : FPDF_FILEWRITE {
+  std::ofstream stream;
+  explicit Save(const fs::path &path) : stream(path, std::ios::binary) {
+    version = 1;
+    WriteBlock = [](FPDF_FILEWRITE *raw, const void *data,
+                    unsigned long length) -> int {
+      auto &file = static_cast<Save *>(raw)->stream;
+      file.write(static_cast<const char *>(data), length);
+      return bool(file);
+    };
+  }
+};
+static void fixture(const fs::path &path) {
+  auto doc = FPDF_CreateNewDocument();
+  check(doc != nullptr, "create document");
+  for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) {
+    auto page = FPDFPage_New(doc, i, i % 2 ? 420 : 595, i % 2 ? 595 : 842);
+    check(page != nullptr, "create page");
+    auto text = FPDFPageObj_NewTextObj(doc, "Helvetica", 18);
+    check(text != nullptr, "create text");
+    std::wstring content =
+        L"SimplyPrint vector fixture " + std::to_wstring(i + 1);
+    check(FPDFText_SetText(
+              text, reinterpret_cast<FPDF_WIDESTRING>(content.c_str())) != 0,
+          "set text");
+    FPDFPageObj_Transform(text, 1, 0, 0, 1, 40, 200);
+    FPDFPage_InsertObject(page, text);
+    auto rect = FPDFPageObj_CreateNewRect(50, 50, 100, 80);
+    FPDFPageObj_SetFillColor(rect, 0, 128, 0, 255);
+    FPDFPath_SetDrawMode(rect, FPDF_FILLMODE_WINDING, 0);
+    FPDFPage_InsertObject(page, rect);
+    if (i == 1)
+      FPDFPage_SetRotation(page, 1);
+    if (i == 2)
+      FPDFPage_SetCropBox(page, 20, 30, 500, 700);
+    if (i == 3) {
+      auto a = FPDFPage_CreateAnnot(page, FPDF_ANNOT_SQUARE);
+      FS_RECTF box{40, 260, 160, 230};
+      check(a != nullptr, "create annotation");
+      FPDFAnnot_SetRect(a, &box);
+      FPDFAnnot_SetFlags(a, FPDF_ANNOT_FLAG_PRINT);
+      FPDFAnnot_SetColor(a, FPDFANNOT_COLORTYPE_Color, 255, 0, 0, 255);
+      FPDFPage_CloseAnnot(a);
+    }
+    check(FPDFPage_GenerateContent(page) != 0, "generate content");
+    FPDF_ClosePage(page);
+  }
+  {
+    Save writer(path);
+    check(FPDF_SaveAsCopy(doc, &writer, FPDF_NO_INCREMENTAL) != 0,
+          "save fixture");
+  }
+  FPDF_CloseDocument(doc);
+}
+int wmain() {
+  winrt::init_apartment(winrt::apartment_type::multi_threaded);
+  wchar_t temp[MAX_PATH];
+  GetTempPathW(MAX_PATH, temp);
+  auto root = fs::path(temp) / (L"socprint-native-test-" + wide(randomID()));
+  fs::create_directories(root);
+  int result = 0;
+  try {
+    PDFController controller(root / L"private");
+    auto source = root / L"Unicode-文档 with spaces.pdf";
+    fixture(source);
+    SetFileAttributesW(source.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY);
+    auto opened = controller.open(source);
+    SetFileAttributesW(source.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL);
+    check(opened["PageCount"] == 7, "page count");
+    fs::remove(source);
+    json opts = {{"Paper", "A4"},
+                 {"Orientation", "portrait"},
+                 {"ScaleMode", "fit"},
+                 {"ScalePercent", 100},
+                 {"Copies", 1},
+                 {"PagesPerSheet", 1},
+                 {"PageRange", "1-3, 5, 2"},
+                 {"AutoRotate", true}};
+    for (int n : {1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 16})
+      for (auto orientation : {"portrait", "landscape"})
+        for (auto scale : {"fit", "fill", "percent"}) {
+          opts["PagesPerSheet"] = n;
+          opts["Orientation"] = orientation;
+          opts["ScaleMode"] = scale;
+          opts["ScalePercent"] = 150;
+          json b = {{"ID", "1"},
+                    {"Action", "preparePDF"},
+                    {"DocumentHandle", opened["DocumentHandle"]},
+                    {"Options", opts},
+                    {"Username", "student"},
+                    {"PrinterID", "psc008"},
+                    {"Queue", "psc008"}};
+          auto previewRequest = b;
+          previewRequest["Sheet"] = 0;
+          auto preview = controller.preview(previewRequest);
+          auto prepared = controller.prepare(b, 1);
+          auto handle = prepared["PreparedHandle"].get<std::string>();
+          auto submission =
+              controller.consume({{"ID", "2"}, {"PreparedHandle", handle}}, 1);
+          rejects([&] {
+            controller.consume({{"ID", "2"}, {"PreparedHandle", handle}}, 1);
+          });
+          auto doc = FPDF_LoadDocument(
+              submission["FilePath"].get<std::string>().c_str(), nullptr);
+          check(doc != nullptr, "prepared document");
+          check(FPDF_GetPageCount(doc) == (5 + n - 1) / n, "sheet count");
+          auto page = FPDF_LoadPage(doc, 0);
+          check(FPDFPage_CountObjects(page) > 0, "vector page objects");
+          check(FPDFPageObj_GetType(FPDFPage_GetObject(page, 0)) ==
+                    FPDF_PAGEOBJ_FORM,
+                "vector form object");
+          check(renderPreview(page) == preview["Image"],
+                "preview/output raster match");
+          auto text = FPDFText_LoadPage(page);
+          check(text && FPDFText_CountChars(text) > 0, "preserved vector text");
+          FPDFText_ClosePage(text);
+          FPDF_ClosePage(page);
+          FPDF_CloseDocument(doc);
+          controller.release(handle);
+        }
+    auto b = json{{"DocumentHandle", opened["DocumentHandle"]},
+                  {"Options", opts},
+                  {"Username", "student"},
+                  {"PrinterID", "psc008"},
+                  {"Queue", "psc008"}};
+    auto prepared = controller.prepare(b, 2);
+    auto handle = prepared["PreparedHandle"].get<std::string>();
+    rejects([&] {
+      controller.consume({{"ID", "3"}, {"PreparedHandle", handle}}, 3);
+    });
+    controller.release(handle);
+    controller.release(opened["DocumentHandle"]);
+    rejects([&] {
+      auto p = b;
+      p["Sheet"] = 0;
+      controller.preview(p);
+    });
+    rejects([&] { controller.release("unknown"); });
+    auto fixtureRoot = fs::path(SOCPRINT_PDF_FIXTURES);
+    rejects([&] { controller.open(fixtureRoot / L"encrypted.pdf"); });
+    opts["PageRange"] = "";
+    opts["PagesPerSheet"] = 1;
+    opts["Orientation"] = "portrait";
+    opts["ScaleMode"] = "fit";
+    for (auto name :
+         {L"embedded_images.pdf", L"text_font.pdf", L"text_form.pdf",
+          L"annotation_highlight_square_with_ap.pdf"}) {
+      auto document = controller.open(fixtureRoot / name);
+      json request = {{"DocumentHandle", document["DocumentHandle"]},
+                      {"Options", opts},
+                      {"Username", "student"},
+                      {"PrinterID", "psc008"},
+                      {"Queue", "psc008"},
+                      {"Sheet", 0}};
+      auto preview = controller.preview(request);
+      auto result = controller.prepare(request, 4);
+      auto handle = result["PreparedHandle"].get<std::string>();
+      auto submitted = controller.consume(
+          {{"ID", "fixture"}, {"PreparedHandle", handle}}, 4);
+      auto output = FPDF_LoadDocument(
+          submitted["FilePath"].get<std::string>().c_str(), nullptr);
+      check(output != nullptr, "upstream fixture output");
+      auto page = FPDF_LoadPage(output, 0);
+      check(page != nullptr && renderPreview(page) == preview["Image"],
+            "upstream fixture preview/output parity");
+      FPDF_ClosePage(page);
+      FPDF_CloseDocument(output);
+      controller.release(handle);
+      controller.release(document["DocumentHandle"]);
+    }
+    auto invalid = root / L"broken.pdf";
+    {
+      std::ofstream f(invalid);
+      f << "%PDF-broken";
+    }
+    rejects([&] { controller.open(invalid); });
+    // Closed sessions are removed; live sessions retain their exclusively held
+    // lock.
+    auto liveRoot = root / L"other";
+    {
+      PDFController first(liveRoot);
+      auto count = std::distance(fs::directory_iterator(liveRoot),
+                                 fs::directory_iterator());
+      {
+        PDFController second(liveRoot);
+        check(std::distance(fs::directory_iterator(liveRoot),
+                            fs::directory_iterator()) == count + 1,
+              "live session preserved");
+      }
+    }
+    std::cout << "Windows PDF snapshots, vector output, preview parity and "
+                 "lifecycle checks passed\n";
+  } catch (const std::exception &e) {
+    std::cerr << e.what() << '\n';
+    result = 1;
+  }
+  std::error_code ec;
+  fs::remove_all(root, ec);
+  winrt::uninit_apartment();
+  return result;
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile
+
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('windows_gates', Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/check-windows-release.py')
+gate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(gate)
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
+    artifact = Path(temporary, gate.ASSET)
+    artifact.write_bytes(b'qualified installer test fixture')
+    good = {'version': '1.2.0', 'platform': 'windows', 'architecture': 'x64', 'minimum_os': 'Windows 11', 'source_commit': 'a'*40, 'source_sha256': 'b'*64, 'signed': True, 'public_ready': True,
+            'artifact': {'name': gate.ASSET, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
+            'checks': {name: {'passed': True, 'evidence': 'Observed fixture evidence'} for name in gate.CHECKS}}
+    def validate(record):
+        return gate.validate(record, '1.2.0', artifact, commit='a'*40, fingerprint='b'*64)
+    assert not validate(good)
+    for key, bad in [('version','1.1.0'), ('signed',False), ('public_ready',False), ('source_commit','c'*40), ('source_sha256','d'*64), ('architecture','arm64')]:
+        value = copy.deepcopy(good); value[key] = bad; assert validate(value), key
+    for name in gate.CHECKS:
+        value = copy.deepcopy(good); value['checks'][name]['passed'] = False; assert validate(value), name
+        value = copy.deepcopy(good); value['checks'][name]['evidence'] = ''; assert validate(value), name
+    for metadata in [None, {}, {'name':gate.ASSET, 'sha256':'0'*64}]:
+        value = copy.deepcopy(good); value['artifact'] = metadata; assert validate(value)
+    artifact.write_bytes(b'changed installer')
+    assert validate(good)
+print('Windows public-release gate checks passed.')

+cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
+project(socprint_native LANGUAGES CXX)
+if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT MSVC OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
+  message(FATAL_ERROR "Build using MSVC for Windows x64")
+endif()
+set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
+set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
+set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
+foreach(required PDFIUM_ROOT WEBVIEW2_ROOT JSON_ROOT)
+  if(NOT DEFINED ${required})
+    message(FATAL_ERROR "${required} must reference a verified dependency")
+  endif()
+endforeach()
+add_library(socprint-native SHARED native/host.cpp native/pdf.cpp)
+add_executable(windows-native-tests ../tests/windows-native.cpp native/pdf.cpp)
+foreach(target socprint-native windows-native-tests)
+  target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE native "${PDFIUM_ROOT}/include" "${WEBVIEW2_ROOT}/build/native/include" "${JSON_ROOT}")
+  target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00)
+  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /W4 /EHsc /utf-8 /permissive- /guard:cf)
+  target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE /DYNAMICBASE /NXCOMPAT /guard:cf)
+  target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE "${PDFIUM_ROOT}/lib/pdfium.lib" ole32 oleaut32 user32 shell32 shlwapi gdi32 advapi32 bcrypt crypt32 windowscodecs propsys comctl32 dwmapi runtimeobject windowsapp winmm version)
+endforeach()
+target_link_libraries(socprint-native PRIVATE "${WEBVIEW2_ROOT}/build/native/x64/WebView2LoaderStatic.lib")
+file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${PDFIUM_ROOT}/fixtures" fixture_dir)
+target_compile_definitions(windows-native-tests PRIVATE SOCPRINT_PDF_FIXTURES="${fixture_dir}")
+enable_testing()
+add_test(NAME windows-native COMMAND windows-native-tests)
+
+add_executable(windows-model-tests ../tests/windows-model.cpp)
+target_include_directories(windows-model-tests PRIVATE "${JSON_ROOT}")
+add_test(NAME windows-model COMMAND windows-model-tests)

+Unicode true
+!include "MUI2.nsh"
+!include "LogicLib.nsh"
+!include "x64.nsh"
+!include "nsDialogs.nsh"
+!ifndef VERSION
+!error "VERSION is required"
+!endif
+!ifndef STAGE
+!error "STAGE is required"
+!endif
+!ifndef OUTPUT
+!error "OUTPUT is required"
+!endif
+Name "SimplyPrint @ SoC"
+OutFile "${OUTPUT}"
+InstallDir "$LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\SimplyPrint-SoC"
+RequestExecutionLevel user
+SetCompressor /SOLID lzma
+VIProductVersion "${VERSION}.0"
+VIAddVersionKey /LANG=1033 "ProductName" "SimplyPrint @ SoC"
+VIAddVersionKey /LANG=1033 "FileDescription" "SimplyPrint @ SoC Setup"
+VIAddVersionKey /LANG=1033 "FileVersion" "${VERSION}"
+VIAddVersionKey /LANG=1033 "LegalCopyright" "SimplyPrint @ SoC contributors"
+!define MUI_ICON "${STAGE}\app.ico"
+!define MUI_UNICON "${STAGE}\app.ico"
+!ifdef SIGN_COMMAND
+!uninstfinalize '${SIGN_COMMAND} "%1"' = 0
+!endif
+!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_WELCOME
+!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_INSTFILES
+!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_FINISH
+!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_CONFIRM
+UninstPage custom un.DataPage un.DataLeave
+!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_INSTFILES
+!insertmacro MUI_LANGUAGE "English"
+Var RemoveData
+Var RemoveCheckbox
+Function .onInit
+  SetShellVarContext current
+  SetRegView 64
+  ${IfNot} ${RunningX64}
+    MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP "SimplyPrint requires Windows 11 x64."
+    Abort
+  ${EndIf}
+  ReadRegStr $0 HKLM "SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion" "CurrentBuildNumber"
+  ${If} $0 < 22000
+    MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP "SimplyPrint requires Windows 11."
+    Abort
+  ${EndIf}
+  FindWindow $0 "SimplyPrintSoC.Window"
+  ${If} $0 != 0
+    MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP "Close SimplyPrint @ SoC and run Setup again."
+    Abort
+  ${EndIf}
+FunctionEnd
+Function un.onInit
+  SetShellVarContext current
+  SetRegView 64
+  StrCpy $RemoveData ${BST_UNCHECKED}
+  FindWindow $0 "SimplyPrintSoC.Window"
+  ${If} $0 != 0
+    MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP "Close SimplyPrint @ SoC before uninstalling."
+    Abort
+  ${EndIf}
+FunctionEnd
+Function un.DataPage
+  nsDialogs::Create 1018
+  Pop $0
+  ${NSD_CreateLabel} 0 0 100% 35u "Your saved accounts, print history and managed SSH keys are kept by default. Existing keys you selected outside the app's data folder are never removed."
+  Pop $0
+  ${NSD_CreateCheckbox} 0 48u 100% 30u "Remove saved credentials, history and app-managed keys"
+  Pop $RemoveCheckbox
+  nsDialogs::Show
+FunctionEnd
+Function un.DataLeave
+  ${NSD_GetState} $RemoveCheckbox $RemoveData
+FunctionEnd

+  SetOutPath "$INSTDIR"
+  SetOverwrite on
+  File "${STAGE}\SimplyPrint.exe"
+  File "${STAGE}\socprint-native.dll"
+  File "${STAGE}\Third-Party-Notices.txt"
+  File "${STAGE}\dependencies.json"
+  File "${STAGE}\app.ico"
+  File "${STAGE}\WebView2Bootstrapper.exe"
+  ; Microsoft's per-user runtime registration. Absence offers the signed bootstrapper.
+  ReadRegStr $0 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate\Clients\{F3017226-FE2A-4295-8BDF-00C3A9A7E4C5}" "pv"
+  ${If} $0 == "0.0.0.0"
+    StrCpy $0 ""
+  ${EndIf}
+  ${If} $0 == ""
+    ReadRegStr $0 HKLM "Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate\Clients\{F3017226-FE2A-4295-8BDF-00C3A9A7E4C5}" "pv"
+  ${EndIf}
+  ${If} $0 == "0.0.0.0"
+    StrCpy $0 ""
+  ${EndIf}
+  ${If} $0 == ""
+    MessageBox MB_YESNO|MB_ICONQUESTION "SimplyPrint needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Install it for your Windows account now? An internet connection is required." IDYES runtimeInstall
+    Abort "WebView2 installation was declined. Run Setup again when ready."
+    runtimeInstall:
+    ExecWait '"$INSTDIR\WebView2Bootstrapper.exe" /silent /install' $1
+    ${If} $1 != 0
+      ${If} $1 != 3010
+        Abort "WebView2 could not be installed. Check your connection and run Setup again."
+      ${EndIf}
+    ${EndIf}
+  ${EndIf}
+  Delete "$INSTDIR\WebView2Bootstrapper.exe"
+  CreateShortcut "$SMPROGRAMS\SimplyPrint @ SoC.lnk" "$INSTDIR\SimplyPrint.exe" "" "$INSTDIR\app.ico"
+  WriteRegStr HKCU "Software\Classes\simplyprint-soc" "" "URL:SimplyPrint Account"
+  WriteRegStr HKCU "Software\Classes\simplyprint-soc" "URL Protocol" ""
+  WriteRegStr HKCU "Software\Classes\simplyprint-soc\shell\open\command" "" '$\"$INSTDIR\SimplyPrint.exe$\" --open-account $\"%1$\"'
+  WriteRegStr HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SimplyPrintSoC" "DisplayName" "SimplyPrint @ SoC"
+  WriteRegStr HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SimplyPrintSoC" "DisplayVersion" "${VERSION}"
+  WriteRegStr HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SimplyPrintSoC" "DisplayIcon" "$INSTDIR\app.ico"
+  WriteRegStr HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SimplyPrintSoC" "UninstallString" '$\"$INSTDIR\Uninstall.exe$\"'
+  WriteRegDWORD HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SimplyPrintSoC" "NoModify" 1
+  WriteRegDWORD HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SimplyPrintSoC" "NoRepair" 1
+  WriteUninstaller "$INSTDIR\Uninstall.exe"
+SectionEnd
+Section "Uninstall"
+  ${If} $RemoveData == ${BST_CHECKED}
+    ExecWait '"$INSTDIR\SimplyPrint.exe" --remove-data' $0
+    ${If} $0 != 0
+      Abort "Account data could not be removed. Close the app and retry."
+    ${EndIf}
+  ${EndIf}
+  Delete "$SMPROGRAMS\SimplyPrint @ SoC.lnk"
+  DeleteRegKey HKCU "Software\Classes\simplyprint-soc"
+  DeleteRegKey HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SimplyPrintSoC"
+  Delete "$INSTDIR\SimplyPrint.exe"
+  Delete "$INSTDIR\socprint-native.dll"
+  Delete "$INSTDIR\Third-Party-Notices.txt"
+  Delete "$INSTDIR\dependencies.json"
+  Delete "$INSTDIR\app.ico"
+  Delete "$INSTDIR\WebView2Bootstrapper.exe"
+  Delete "$INSTDIR\Uninstall.exe"
+  RMDir "$INSTDIR"
+SectionEnd

+#pragma once
+#include <windows.h>
+using sp_message_fn = void(__stdcall *)(const char *);
+using sp_reveal_fn = void(__stdcall *)(const char *, const char *);
+using sp_terms_fn = int(__stdcall *)();
+extern "C"
+    __declspec(dllexport) int __stdcall sp_run(const char *, const wchar_t *,
+                                               sp_message_fn, sp_reveal_fn,
+                                               sp_terms_fn);
+extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) void __stdcall sp_respond(const char *);

+#include "bridge.h"
+#include "pdf.h"
+#include <WebView2.h>
+#include <atomic>
+#include <commctrl.h>
+#include <condition_variable>
+#include <deque>
+#include <dwmapi.h>
+#include <functional>
+#include <mutex>
+#include <propkey.h>
+#include <propvarutil.h>
+#include <set>
+#include <shellapi.h>
+#include <shlobj.h>
+#include <shlwapi.h>
+#include <thread>
+#include <userconsentverifierinterop.h>
+#include <winrt/Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.h>
+#include <winrt/Windows.Foundation.h>
+#include <winrt/Windows.Security.Credentials.UI.h>
+#include <winrt/Windows.UI.Notifications.h>
+#include <wrl.h>
+
+namespace sp {
+using Microsoft::WRL::Callback;
+using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;
+namespace fs = std::filesystem;
+constexpr wchar_t appURL[] = L"https://socprint.invalid/index.html";
+constexpr wchar_t appOrigin[] = L"https://socprint.invalid/";
+constexpr wchar_t className[] = L"SimplyPrintSoC.Window";
+constexpr wchar_t appID[] = L"SimplyPrint.SoC";
+constexpr UINT responseMessage = WM_APP + 1;
+constexpr UINT taskMessage = WM_APP + 2;
+struct Host {
+  HWND window = nullptr;
+  ComPtr<ICoreWebView2Controller> controller;
+  ComPtr<ICoreWebView2> view;
+  ComPtr<ICoreWebView2Environment> environment;
+  json assets;
+  std::wstring managed;
+  sp_message_fn message = nullptr;
+  sp_reveal_fn reveal = nullptr;
+  sp_terms_fn terms = nullptr;
+  std::atomic<bool> closing{false};
+  std::atomic<uint64_t> revision{0};
+  std::atomic<bool> authentication{false};
+  std::set<std::wstring> keys;
+  std::mutex jobsMutex, uiMutex;
+  std::condition_variable wake;
+  std::deque<std::function<void(PDFController &)>> jobs;
+  std::deque<std::function<void()>> ui;
+  std::thread worker;
+  bool stop = false;
+  bool ready = false;
+  bool smoke = false;
+  bool smokeSucceeded = false;
+  std::string pendingCommand;
+  void send(json reply) {
+    auto *data = new std::wstring(wide(reply.dump()));
+    if (closing || !PostMessageW(window, responseMessage, 0,
+                                 reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(data)))
+      delete data;
+  }
+  void uiTask(std::function<void()> fn) {
+    if (closing)
+      return;
+    {
+      std::lock_guard lock(uiMutex);
+      ui.push_back(std::move(fn));
+    }
+    PostMessageW(window, taskMessage, 0, 0);
+  }
+  void work(std::function<void(PDFController &)> fn) {
+    std::lock_guard lock(jobsMutex);
+    if (!stop) {
+      jobs.push_back(std::move(fn));
+      wake.notify_one();
+    }
+  }
+  bool trusted() {
+    if (!view)
+      return false;
+    LPWSTR source = nullptr;
+    bool ok = SUCCEEDED(view->get_Source(&source)) && source &&
+              trustedDocument(source);
+    CoTaskMemFree(source);
+    return ok;
+  }
+  void command(const std::string &command) {
+    if (!ready) {
+      pendingCommand = command;
+      return;
+    }
+    if (trusted())
+      view->PostWebMessageAsJson(
+          wide(json{{"Command", json::array({command})}}.dump()).c_str());
+  }
+  void startWorker(const fs::path &root) {
+    worker = std::thread([this, root] {
+      winrt::init_apartment(winrt::apartment_type::multi_threaded);
+      try {
+        PDFController pdf(root);
+        for (;;) {
+          std::function<void(PDFController &)> task;
+          {
+            std::unique_lock lock(jobsMutex);
+            wake.wait(lock, [this] { return stop || !jobs.empty(); });
+            if (stop && jobs.empty())
+              break;
+            task = std::move(jobs.front());
+            jobs.pop_front();
+          }
+          task(pdf);
+        }
+      } catch (const std::exception &) {
+        uiTask([this] {
+          MessageBoxW(window,
+                      L"Private document storage could not be opened. Check "
+                      L"your Windows account permissions and restart the app.",
+                      L"SimplyPrint @ SoC", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
+          DestroyWindow(window);
+        });
+      }
+      winrt::uninit_apartment();
+    });
+  }
+  void stopWorker() {
+    {
+      std::lock_guard lock(jobsMutex);
+      stop = true;
+      jobs.clear();
+    }
+    wake.notify_one();
+    if (worker.joinable())
+      worker.join();
+  }
+};
+static Host *host = nullptr; // Retained until process exit; asynchronous OS
+                             // callbacks may still complete.
+static std::wstring knownFolder(REFKNOWNFOLDERID id) {
+  PWSTR raw = nullptr;
+  require(SUCCEEDED(SHGetKnownFolderPath(id, 0, nullptr, &raw)),
+          "Could not find application storage.");
+  std::wstring value(raw);
+  CoTaskMemFree(raw);
+  return value;
+}
+static std::wstring executable() {
+  std::wstring path(32768, 0);
+  DWORD n =
+      GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, path.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(path.size()));
+  require(n > 0 && n < path.size(), "Could not find the app executable.");
+  path.resize(n);
+  return path;
+}
+static bool helpURL(const std::wstring &value) { // Use the platform URI parser
+                                                 // rather than prefix matching.
+  try {
+    winrt::Windows::Foundation::Uri uri(value);
+    auto scheme = std::wstring(uri.SchemeName()),
+         name = std::wstring(uri.Host()), path = std::wstring(uri.Path());
+    std::transform(name.begin(), name.end(), name.begin(), ::towlower);
+    bool nus =
+        name == L"nus.edu.sg" ||
+        (name.size() > 11 && name.substr(name.size() - 11) == L".nus.edu.sg");
+    return scheme == L"https" && uri.UserName().empty() &&
+           uri.Password().empty() && uri.Port() == 443 &&
+           (nus || (name == L"ppannawitt.github.io" &&
+                    path.rfind(L"/print-soc/", 0) == 0));
+  } catch (...) {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+static json dialog(const json &b) {
+  auto title = wide(b.value("Title", std::string("SimplyPrint @ SoC"))),
+       message = wide(b.value("Message", std::string()));
+  std::vector<std::wstring> labels;
+  if (b.contains("Buttons"))
+    for (auto &item : b["Buttons"])
+      labels.push_back(wide(item.get<std::string>()));
+  if (labels.empty())
+    labels.push_back(L"OK");
+  std::vector<TASKDIALOG_BUTTON> buttons;
+  for (size_t i = 0; i < labels.size(); ++i)
+    buttons.push_back({100 + static_cast<int>(i), labels[i].c_str()});
+  TASKDIALOGCONFIG cfg{sizeof(cfg)};
+  cfg.hwndParent = host->window;
+  cfg.dwFlags = TDF_ALLOW_DIALOG_CANCELLATION | TDF_SIZE_TO_CONTENT;
+  cfg.pszWindowTitle = L"SimplyPrint @ SoC";
+  cfg.pszMainInstruction = title.c_str();
+  cfg.pszContent = message.c_str();
+  cfg.cButtons = static_cast<UINT>(buttons.size());
+  cfg.pButtons = buttons.data();
+  cfg.nDefaultButton = 100;
+  cfg.pszMainIcon = b.value("Style", std::string()) == "error"
+                        ? TD_ERROR_ICON
+                        : TD_INFORMATION_ICON;
+  int chosen = IDCANCEL;
+  require(SUCCEEDED(TaskDialogIndirect(&cfg, &chosen, nullptr, nullptr)),
+          "Could not open the confirmation dialog.");
+  return {{"ButtonIndex", chosen >= 100 ? chosen - 100 : -1}};
+}
+static void clipboard(const std::string &text) {
+  auto value = wide(text);
+  require(OpenClipboard(host->window) != 0, "Could not open the clipboard.");
+  struct End {
+    ~End() { CloseClipboard(); }
+  } end;
+  require(EmptyClipboard() != 0, "Could not clear the clipboard.");
+  HGLOBAL memory =
+      GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, (value.size() + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t));
+  require(memory != nullptr, "Could not copy text.");
+  void *ptr = GlobalLock(memory);
+  if (!ptr) {
+    GlobalFree(memory);
+    throw std::runtime_error("Could not copy text.");
+  }
+  memcpy(ptr, value.c_str(), (value.size() + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t));
+  GlobalUnlock(memory);
+  if (!SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, memory)) {
+    GlobalFree(memory);
+    throw std::runtime_error("Could not copy text.");
+  }
+}
+static void shortcut() {
+  ComPtr<IShellLinkW> link;
+  winrt::check_hresult(CoCreateInstance(
+      CLSID_ShellLink, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&link)));
+  auto exe = executable();
+  winrt::check_hresult(link->SetPath(exe.c_str()));
+  winrt::check_hresult(
+      link->SetWorkingDirectory(fs::path(exe).parent_path().c_str()));
+  winrt::check_hresult(link->SetIconLocation(exe.c_str(), 0));
+  ComPtr<IPropertyStore> store;
+  winrt::check_hresult(link.As(&store));
+  PROPVARIANT value{};
+  winrt::check_hresult(InitPropVariantFromString(appID, &value));
+  HRESULT result = store->SetValue(PKEY_AppUserModel_ID, value);
+  PropVariantClear(&value);
+  winrt::check_hresult(result);
+  winrt::check_hresult(store->Commit());
+  ComPtr<IPersistFile> file;
+  winrt::check_hresult(link.As(&file));
+  auto path =
+      fs::path(knownFolder(FOLDERID_Programs)) / L"SimplyPrint @ SoC.lnk";
+  winrt::check_hresult(file->Save(path.c_str(), TRUE));
+}
+static json notification(const json &b) {
+  using namespace winrt::Windows::UI::Notifications;
+  using namespace winrt::Windows::Data::Xml::Dom;
+  auto status = b.value("Status", std::string());
+  std::string title = "SoC jump access needs attention", text;
+  if (status == "noKey")
+    text = "Set up an SSH key in Account to print from COM2 and other campus "
+           "locations.";
+  else if (status == "rejected")
+    text = "The selected SSH key was rejected. Open Account to enroll it or "
+           "choose another key.";
+  else if (status == "enrollmentFailed")
+    text = "The SSH key update was not accepted. Open Account to review your "
+           "keys.";
+  else if (status == "locked")
+    text = "Enter the selected SSH key's passphrase in Account.";
+  else if (status == "invalidKey")
+    text = "Choose a readable SSH private key in Account.";
+  else if (status == "accountAuthentication")
+    text = "Update your SoC password in Account.";
+  else
+    throw std::runtime_error("That jump-access notification is unavailable.");
+  try {
+    shortcut();
+    XmlDocument xml;
+    xml.LoadXml(
+        L"<toast activationType='protocol' "
+        L"launch='simplyprint-soc://account'><visual><binding "
+        L"template='ToastGeneric'><text></text><text></text></binding></"
+        L"visual><actions><action content='Open Account' "
+        L"activationType='protocol' "
+        L"arguments='simplyprint-soc://account'/><action content='Later' "
+        L"activationType='system' arguments='dismiss'/></actions></toast>");
+    auto nodes = xml.GetElementsByTagName(L"text");
+    nodes.Item(0).AppendChild(xml.CreateTextNode(wide(title)));
+    nodes.Item(1).AppendChild(xml.CreateTextNode(wide(text)));
+    ToastNotification toast(xml);
+    toast.Tag(L"jump-setup");
+    toast.Group(L"socprint");
+    ToastNotificationManager::CreateToastNotifier(appID).Show(toast);
+    return {{"Delivered", true}};
+  } catch (...) {
+    return {{"Delivered", false}};
+  }
+}
+static winrt::fire_and_forget authenticate(json b, uint64_t revision) {
+  using namespace winrt::Windows::Security::Credentials::UI;
+  using namespace winrt::Windows::Foundation;
+  auto *h = host;
+  std::string secret = b.value("Secret", std::string());
+  if (secret != "password" && secret != "keyPassphrase") {
+    h->send(failure(b, "invalidSecret",
+                    "That saved credential cannot be revealed."));
+    co_return;
+  }
+  if (h->authentication.exchange(true)) {
+    h->send(failure(b, "authenticationBusy",
+                    "Finish the current Windows authentication first."));
+    co_return;
+  }
+  try {
+    auto factory = winrt::get_activation_factory<UserConsentVerifier,
+                                                 IUserConsentVerifierInterop>();
+    IAsyncOperation<UserConsentVerificationResult> operation{nullptr};
+    winrt::hstring reason =
+        L"Verify your identity to reveal this saved SimplyPrint credential.";
+    winrt::check_hresult(factory->RequestVerificationForWindowAsync(
+        h->window, winrt::get_abi(reason),
+        winrt::guid_of<IAsyncOperation<UserConsentVerificationResult>>(),
+        winrt::put_abi(operation)));
+    auto result = co_await operation;
+    if (!h->closing) {
+      if (result == UserConsentVerificationResult::Verified &&
+          h->revision == revision && h->terms()) {
+        if (b.value("Retrieve", false))
+          h->reveal(b["ID"].get<std::string>().c_str(), secret.c_str());
+        else
+          h->send(success(b, {{"Authorized", true}}));
+      } else
+        h->send(failure(b,
+                        result == UserConsentVerificationResult::Canceled
+                            ? "authenticationCancelled"
+                            : "localAuthFailed",
+                        "Windows authentication did not succeed or the account "
+                        "changed. Saved credentials remain hidden."));
+    }
+  } catch (...) {
+    if (!h->closing)
+      h->send(failure(b, "localAuthUnavailable",
+                      "Windows Hello or PIN verification is unavailable. You "
+                      "can replace the saved credential in Account."));
+  }
+  h->authentication = false;
+}
+static void handle(json b) {
+  request(b);
+  auto action = b["Action"].get<std::string>();
+  auto *h = host;
+  if (action != "initialize" && action != "acceptTerms" &&
+      action != "quitApp" && !h->terms()) {
+    h->send(failure(b, "termsRequired",
+                    "Review and accept the terms before continuing."));
+    return;
+  }
+  if (b.contains("KeyPath") && !b["KeyPath"].get<std::string>().empty()) {
+    auto path = fs::weakly_canonical(wide(b["KeyPath"]));
+    auto managed = fs::weakly_canonical(h->managed);
+    auto relative = path.lexically_relative(managed);
+    bool own = !relative.empty() && !relative.is_absolute() &&
+               *relative.begin() != L"..";
+    require(own || h->keys.count(path.wstring()),
+            "Choose the SSH key using the file picker again.");
+  }
+  if (action == "saveCredentials" || action == "signOut" ||
+      action == "createKey" || action == "useKey" ||
+      action == "createAndEnrollKey" || action == "signIn")
+    ++h->revision;
+  if (action == "nativeAlert") {
+    h->send(success(b, dialog(b)));
+    return;
+  }
+  if (action == "copyText") {
+    clipboard(b.value("Text", std::string()));
+    h->send(success(b, {{"Copied", true}}));
+    return;
+  }
+  if (action == "openURL") {
+    auto url = wide(b.value("URL", std::string()));
+    require(helpURL(url), "This help link could not be opened.");
+    require(reinterpret_cast<INT_PTR>(
+                ShellExecuteW(h->window, L"open", url.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr,
+                              SW_SHOWNORMAL)) > 32,
+            "This help link could not be opened.");
+    h->send(success(b, {{"Opened", true}}));
+    return;
+  }
+  if (action == "showJumpSetupNotification") {
+    h->send(success(b, notification(b)));
+    return;
+  }
+  if (action == "clearJumpSetupNotification") {
+    try {
+      winrt::Windows::UI::Notifications::ToastNotificationManager::History()
+          .Remove(L"jump-setup", L"socprint", appID);
+    } catch (...) {
+    }
+    h->send(success(b, {{"Cleared", true}}));
+    return;
+  }
+  if (action == "revealSecret") {
+    authenticate(b, h->revision);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (action == "quitApp") {
+    PostMessageW(h->window, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (action == "choosePDF" || action == "chooseKey") {
+    ComPtr<IFileOpenDialog> picker;
+    winrt::check_hresult(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_FileOpenDialog, nullptr,
+                                          CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER,
+                                          IID_PPV_ARGS(&picker)));
+    picker->SetOptions(FOS_FILEMUSTEXIST | FOS_PATHMUSTEXIST |
+                       FOS_FORCEFILESYSTEM | FOS_NOCHANGEDIR |
+                       FOS_DONTADDTORECENT);
+    COMDLG_FILTERSPEC filter{L"PDF documents", L"*.pdf"};
+    if (action == "choosePDF")
+      picker->SetFileTypes(1, &filter);
+    picker->SetTitle(action == "choosePDF" ? L"Choose a PDF to print"
+                                           : L"Choose your SSH private key");
+    HRESULT result = picker->Show(h->window);
+    if (result == HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_CANCELLED)) {
+      h->send(success(b, {{"Cancelled", true}}));
+      return;
+    }
+    winrt::check_hresult(result);
+    ComPtr<IShellItem> item;
+    winrt::check_hresult(picker->GetResult(&item));
+    PWSTR raw = nullptr;
+    winrt::check_hresult(item->GetDisplayName(SIGDN_FILESYSPATH, &raw));
+    fs::path path(raw);
+    CoTaskMemFree(raw);
+    if (action == "chooseKey") {
+      h->keys.insert(fs::weakly_canonical(path).wstring());
+      h->send(success(b, {{"Path", utf8(path.wstring())}}));
+    } else
+      h->work([h, b, path](PDFController &pdf) {
+        try {
+          h->send(success(b, pdf.open(path)));
+        } catch (const std::exception &e) {
+          h->send(failure(b, "invalidPDF", e.what()));
+        }
+      });
+    return;
+  }
+  if (action == "previewPDF" || action == "preparePDF" ||
+      action == "releaseDocument" || action == "submitPrint") {
+    uint64_t revision = h->revision;
+    h->work([h, b, action, revision](PDFController &pdf) {
+      try {
+        if (action == "submitPrint") {
+          require(h->revision == revision,
+                  "The account changed. Prepare the PDF again.");
+          auto request = pdf.consume(b, revision).dump();
+          h->message(request.c_str());
+        } else if (action == "preparePDF")
+          h->send(success(b, pdf.prepare(b, revision)));
+        else if (action == "previewPDF")
+          h->send(success(b, pdf.preview(b)));
+        else
+          h->send(success(b, pdf.release(b["Handle"])));
+      } catch (const std::exception &e) {
+        h->send(failure(b, "pdfPreparationFailed", e.what()));
+      }
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+  auto raw = b.dump();
+  h->message(raw.c_str());
+}
+static void theme() {
+  DWORD light = 1, size = sizeof(light);
+  RegGetValueW(
+      HKEY_CURRENT_USER,
+      L"Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Themes\\Personalize",
+      L"AppsUseLightTheme", RRF_RT_REG_DWORD, nullptr, &light, &size);
+  BOOL dark = !light;
+  DwmSetWindowAttribute(host->window, 20, &dark, sizeof(dark));
+}
+static LRESULT CALLBACK windowProc(HWND window, UINT message, WPARAM w,
+                                   LPARAM l) {
+  auto *h = host;
+  if (message == RegisterWindowMessageW(L"SimplyPrint.SoC.Activate")) {
+    ShowWindow(window, SW_RESTORE);
+    SetForegroundWindow(window);
+    if (w == 1)
+      h->command("settings");
+    return 0;
+  }
+  switch (message) {
+  case WM_SIZE:
+    if (h && h->controller) {
+      RECT rect;
+      GetClientRect(window, &rect);
+      h->controller->put_Bounds(rect);
+    }
+    return 0;
+  case WM_GETMINMAXINFO: {
+    auto *info = reinterpret_cast<MINMAXINFO *>(l);
+    UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(window);
+    info->ptMinTrackSize = {MulDiv(760, dpi, 96), MulDiv(500, dpi, 96)};
+    return 0;
+  }
+  case WM_DPICHANGED: {
+    auto *rect = reinterpret_cast<RECT *>(l);
+    SetWindowPos(window, nullptr, rect->left, rect->top,
+                 rect->right - rect->left, rect->bottom - rect->top,
+                 SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
+    return 0;
+  }
+  case WM_SETTINGCHANGE:
+    if (h)
+      theme();
+    break;
+  case WM_COMMAND:
+    if (LOWORD(w) == 101)
+      h->command("open");
+    else if (LOWORD(w) == 102)
+      h->command("print");
+    else if (LOWORD(w) == 103)
+      h->command("settings");
+    else if (LOWORD(w) == 104)
+      PostMessageW(window, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
+    else if (LOWORD(w) == 105)
+      MessageBoxW(window,
+                  L"SimplyPrint @ SoC\nIndependent student project. Not "
+                  L"affiliated with NUS.",
+                  L"About SimplyPrint @ SoC", MB_OK);
+    return 0;
+  case responseMessage: {
+    std::unique_ptr<std::wstring> data(reinterpret_cast<std::wstring *>(l));
+    if (h && !h->closing && h->trusted()) {
+      try {
+        auto reply = json::parse(utf8(*data));
+        if (reply.value("OK", false) && reply.contains("Data") &&
+            reply["Data"].is_object()) {
+          auto &d = reply["Data"];
+          if (d.contains("KeyPath") && d["KeyPath"].is_string() &&
+              !d["KeyPath"].get<std::string>().empty())
+            h->keys.insert(fs::weakly_canonical(wide(d["KeyPath"])).wstring());
+        }
+        HRESULT sent = h->view->PostWebMessageAsJson(data->c_str());
+        if (h->smoke && SUCCEEDED(sent) && reply.value("OK", false) &&
+            reply.contains("Data") && reply["Data"].is_object() &&
+            reply["Data"].contains("Platform") &&
+            reply["Data"].contains("TermsVersion")) {
+          h->smokeSucceeded = true;
+          PostMessageW(window, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
+        }
+      } catch (...) {
+      }
+    }
+    return 0;
+  }
+  case taskMessage: {
+    std::deque<std::function<void()>> tasks;
+    {
+      std::lock_guard lock(h->uiMutex);
+      tasks.swap(h->ui);
+    }
+    for (auto &fn : tasks)
+      fn();
+    return 0;
+  }
+  case WM_CLOSE:
+    DestroyWindow(window);
+    return 0;
+  case WM_TIMER:
+    if (h && h->smoke && w == 1) {
+      KillTimer(window, 1);
+      DestroyWindow(window);
+      return 0;
+    }
+    break;
+  case WM_DESTROY:
+    if (h)
+      h->closing = true;
+    PostQuitMessage(0);
+    return 0;
+  }
+  return DefWindowProcW(window, message, w, l);
+}
+static void setupWebView() {
+  auto *h = host;
+  winrt::check_hresult(h->environment->CreateCoreWebView2Controller(
+      h->window,
+      Callback<ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2ControllerCompletedHandler>(
+          [h](HRESULT result, ICoreWebView2Controller *controller) -> HRESULT {
+            if (h->closing)
+              return S_OK;
+            if (FAILED(result) || !controller) {
+              MessageBoxW(h->window,
+                          L"WebView2 could not create the app window. Repair "
+                          L"the WebView2 Runtime and try again.",
+                          L"SimplyPrint @ SoC", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
+              DestroyWindow(h->window);
+              return S_OK;
+            }
+            h->controller = controller;
+            controller->get_CoreWebView2(&h->view);
+            auto v = h->view;
+            ComPtr<ICoreWebView2Settings> settings;
+            v->get_Settings(&settings);
+            settings->put_AreDevToolsEnabled(FALSE);
+            settings->put_AreDefaultContextMenusEnabled(FALSE);
+            settings->put_AreHostObjectsAllowed(FALSE);
+            ComPtr<ICoreWebView2Settings3> settings3;
+            if (SUCCEEDED(settings.As(&settings3)))
+              settings3->put_AreBrowserAcceleratorKeysEnabled(FALSE);
+            settings->put_IsStatusBarEnabled(FALSE);
+            settings->put_IsWebMessageEnabled(TRUE);
+            settings->put_AreDefaultScriptDialogsEnabled(FALSE);
+            EventRegistrationToken token;
+            v->add_NavigationStarting(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2NavigationStartingEventHandler>(
+                    [](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                       ICoreWebView2NavigationStartingEventArgs *args)
+                        -> HRESULT {
+                      LPWSTR raw = nullptr;
+                      args->get_Uri(&raw);
+                      args->put_Cancel(!raw || !trustedDocument(raw));
+                      CoTaskMemFree(raw);
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            v->add_FrameNavigationStarting(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2NavigationStartingEventHandler>(
+                    [](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                       ICoreWebView2NavigationStartingEventArgs *args)
+                        -> HRESULT {
+                      args->put_Cancel(TRUE);
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            v->add_NewWindowRequested(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2NewWindowRequestedEventHandler>(
+                    [](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                       ICoreWebView2NewWindowRequestedEventArgs *args)
+                        -> HRESULT {
+                      args->put_Handled(TRUE);
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            v->add_PermissionRequested(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2PermissionRequestedEventHandler>(
+                    [](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                       ICoreWebView2PermissionRequestedEventArgs *args)
+                        -> HRESULT {
+                      args->put_State(COREWEBVIEW2_PERMISSION_STATE_DENY);
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            ComPtr<ICoreWebView2_4> view4;
+            if (SUCCEEDED(v.As(&view4)))
+              view4->add_DownloadStarting(
+                  Callback<ICoreWebView2DownloadStartingEventHandler>(
+                      [](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                         ICoreWebView2DownloadStartingEventArgs *args)
+                          -> HRESULT {
+                        args->put_Cancel(TRUE);
+                        return S_OK;
+                      })
+                      .Get(),
+                  &token);
+            ComPtr<ICoreWebView2Controller4> controller4;
+            if (SUCCEEDED(
+                    controller->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&controller4))))
+              controller4->put_AllowExternalDrop(FALSE);
+            v->AddWebResourceRequestedFilter(
+                L"*", COREWEBVIEW2_WEB_RESOURCE_CONTEXT_ALL);
+            v->add_WebResourceRequested(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2WebResourceRequestedEventHandler>(
+                    [h](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                        ICoreWebView2WebResourceRequestedEventArgs *args)
+                        -> HRESULT {
+                      try {
+                        ComPtr<ICoreWebView2WebResourceRequest> request;
+                        args->get_Request(&request);
+                        LPWSTR raw = nullptr;
+                        request->get_Uri(&raw);
+                        std::wstring url = raw ? raw : L"";
+                        CoTaskMemFree(raw);
+                        std::string name;
+                        bool allowed = url.rfind(appOrigin, 0) == 0;
+                        if (allowed)
+                          name =
+                              utf8(url.substr(std::wstring(appOrigin).size()));
+                        allowed = allowed && h->assets.contains(name) &&
+                                  h->assets[name].is_string();
+                        std::string content =
+                            allowed ? h->assets[name].get<std::string>()
+                                    : "Blocked";
+                        ComPtr<IStream> stream;
+                        winrt::check_hresult(
+                            CreateStreamOnHGlobal(nullptr, TRUE, &stream));
+                        ULONG written = 0;
+                        stream->Write(content.data(),
+                                      static_cast<ULONG>(content.size()),
+                                      &written);
+                        LARGE_INTEGER zero{};
+                        stream->Seek(zero, STREAM_SEEK_SET, nullptr);
+                        auto ext = fs::path(name).extension().string();
+                        std::wstring type = ext == ".html" ? L"text/html"
+                                            : ext == ".js"
+                                                ? L"application/javascript"
+                                            : ext == ".css" ? L"text/css"
+                                            : ext == ".svg" ? L"image/svg+xml"
+                                                            : L"text/plain";
+                        std::wstring headers =
+                            L"Content-Type: " + type +
+                            L"; charset=utf-8\r\nCache-Control: "
+                            L"no-store\r\nX-Content-Type-Options: nosniff";
+                        ComPtr<ICoreWebView2WebResourceResponse> response;
+                        winrt::check_hresult(
+                            h->environment->CreateWebResourceResponse(
+                                stream.Get(), allowed ? 200 : 403,
+                                allowed ? L"OK" : L"Forbidden", headers.c_str(),
+                                &response));
+                        args->put_Response(response.Get());
+                      } catch (...) {
+                        return E_FAIL;
+                      }
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            v->add_WebMessageReceived(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventHandler>(
+                    [h](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                        ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventArgs *args)
+                        -> HRESULT {
+                      LPWSTR source = nullptr;
+                      args->get_Source(&source);
+                      bool trusted =
+                          source && trustedDocument(source) && h->trusted();
+                      CoTaskMemFree(source);
+                      if (!trusted)
+                        return S_OK;
+                      LPWSTR raw = nullptr;
+                      if (FAILED(args->get_WebMessageAsJson(&raw)))
+                        return S_OK;
+                      json body = json::object();
+                      try {
+                        require(raw != nullptr && wcslen(raw) <= 262144,
+                                "The request is too large.");
+                        auto payload = utf8(raw);
+                        require(payload.size() <= 262144,
+                                "The request is too large.");
+                        body = json::parse(payload);
+                        handle(body);
+                      } catch (const std::exception &e) {
+                        h->send(failure(body, "invalidRequest", e.what()));
+                      } catch (...) {
+                        h->send(failure(
+                            body, "nativeError",
+                            "The Windows action could not be completed."));
+                      }
+                      CoTaskMemFree(raw);
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            v->add_ScriptDialogOpening(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2ScriptDialogOpeningEventHandler>(
+                    [h](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                        ICoreWebView2ScriptDialogOpeningEventArgs *args)
+                        -> HRESULT {
+                      if (!h->trusted())
+                        return S_OK;
+                      LPWSTR raw = nullptr;
+                      args->get_Message(&raw);
+                      std::string message = raw ? utf8(raw) : "";
+                      CoTaskMemFree(raw);
+                      COREWEBVIEW2_SCRIPT_DIALOG_KIND kind;
+                      args->get_Kind(&kind);
+                      try {
+                        json b = {
+                            {"Title",
+                             kind == COREWEBVIEW2_SCRIPT_DIALOG_KIND_CONFIRM
+                                 ? "Confirm"
+                                 : "SimplyPrint @ SoC"},
+                            {"Message", message},
+                            {"Buttons",
+                             kind == COREWEBVIEW2_SCRIPT_DIALOG_KIND_CONFIRM
+                                 ? json::array({"Cancel", "Continue"})
+                                 : json::array({"OK"})}};
+                        auto d = dialog(b);
+                        if (kind != COREWEBVIEW2_SCRIPT_DIALOG_KIND_CONFIRM ||
+                            d["ButtonIndex"] == 1)
+                          args->Accept();
+                      } catch (...) {
+                      }
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            v->add_ProcessFailed(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2ProcessFailedEventHandler>(
+                    [h](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                        ICoreWebView2ProcessFailedEventArgs *) -> HRESULT {
+                      h->uiTask([h] {
+                        MessageBoxW(
+                            h->window,
+                            L"The app display stopped. Reopen SimplyPrint and "
+                            L"check Jobs before sending a document again.",
+                            L"SimplyPrint @ SoC", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
+                        PostMessageW(h->window, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
+                      });
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            v->add_NavigationCompleted(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2NavigationCompletedEventHandler>(
+                    [h](ICoreWebView2 *,
+                        ICoreWebView2NavigationCompletedEventArgs *)
+                        -> HRESULT {
+                      h->ready = h->trusted();
+                      if (h->ready && !h->pendingCommand.empty()) {
+                        auto command = h->pendingCommand;
+                        h->pendingCommand.clear();
+                        h->command(command);
+                      }
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            controller->add_AcceleratorKeyPressed(
+                Callback<ICoreWebView2AcceleratorKeyPressedEventHandler>(
+                    [h](ICoreWebView2Controller *,
+                        ICoreWebView2AcceleratorKeyPressedEventArgs *args)
+                        -> HRESULT {
+                      COREWEBVIEW2_KEY_EVENT_KIND kind;
+                      args->get_KeyEventKind(&kind);
+                      UINT key;
+                      args->get_VirtualKey(&key);
+                      if ((kind == COREWEBVIEW2_KEY_EVENT_KIND_KEY_DOWN ||
+                           kind ==
+                               COREWEBVIEW2_KEY_EVENT_KIND_SYSTEM_KEY_DOWN) &&
+                          (GetKeyState(VK_CONTROL) & 0x8000) &&
+                          (key == 'O' || key == 'P' || key == VK_OEM_COMMA)) {
+                        args->put_Handled(TRUE);
+                        auto command = key == 'O'   ? "open"
+                                       : key == 'P' ? "print"
+                                                    : "settings";
+                        h->uiTask([h, command] { h->command(command); });
+                      }
+                      return S_OK;
+                    })
+                    .Get(),
+                &token);
+            RECT bounds;
+            GetClientRect(h->window, &bounds);
+            controller->put_Bounds(bounds);
+            controller->put_IsVisible(TRUE);
+            v->Navigate(appURL);
+            return S_OK;
+          })
+          .Get()));
+}
+} // namespace sp
+extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) int __stdcall sp_run(const char *assets,
+                                                      const wchar_t *managed,
+                                                      sp_message_fn message,
+                                                      sp_reveal_fn reveal,
+                                                      sp_terms_fn terms) {
+  using namespace sp;
+  try {
+    winrt::init_apartment(winrt::apartment_type::single_threaded);
+    SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2);
+    SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID(appID);
+    host = new Host();
+    host->smoke = wcsstr(GetCommandLineW(), L"--smoke-test") != nullptr;
+    host->assets = json::parse(assets);
+    host->managed = managed;
+    host->message = message;
+    host->reveal = reveal;
+    host->terms = terms;
+    if (wcsstr(GetCommandLineW(), L"--open-account"))
+      host->pendingCommand = "settings";
+    INITCOMMONCONTROLSEX controls{sizeof(controls), ICC_STANDARD_CLASSES};
+    InitCommonControlsEx(&controls);
+    WNDCLASSW cls{};
+    cls.lpfnWndProc = windowProc;
+    cls.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
+    cls.lpszClassName = className;
+    cls.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
+    cls.hIcon = LoadIconW(GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), MAKEINTRESOURCEW(101));
+    RegisterClassW(&cls);
+    HMENU menu = CreateMenu(), file = CreatePopupMenu(),
+          help = CreatePopupMenu();
+    AppendMenuW(file, MF_STRING, 101, L"&Open PDF…\tCtrl+O");
+    AppendMenuW(file, MF_STRING, 102, L"&Print…\tCtrl+P");
+    AppendMenuW(file, MF_STRING, 103, L"&Account…\tCtrl+,");
+    AppendMenuW(file, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, nullptr);
+    AppendMenuW(file, MF_STRING, 104, L"E&xit");
+    AppendMenuW(menu, MF_POPUP, reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(file), L"&File");
+    AppendMenuW(help, MF_STRING, 105, L"&About SimplyPrint @ SoC");
+    AppendMenuW(menu, MF_POPUP, reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(help), L"&Help");
+    UINT dpi = GetDpiForSystem();
+    int width =
+            std::min(MulDiv(1180, dpi, 96), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN) - 40),
+        height =
+            std::min(MulDiv(780, dpi, 96), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN) - 80);
+    host->window = CreateWindowExW(
+        0, className, L"SimplyPrint @ SoC", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, CW_USEDEFAULT,
+        CW_USEDEFAULT, width, height, nullptr, menu, cls.hInstance, nullptr);
+    require(host->window != nullptr, "Could not create the app window.");
+    if (host->smoke)
+      require(SetTimer(host->window, 1, 45000, nullptr) != 0,
+              "Could not start the launch verification timer.");
+    theme();
+    ShowWindow(host->window, SW_SHOW);
+    auto local = fs::path(knownFolder(FOLDERID_LocalAppData)) / L"socprint";
+    fs::create_directories(local);
+    protect(local);
+    auto cache = local / L"webview";
+    fs::create_directories(cache);
+    protect(cache);
+    host->startWorker(local / L"private");
+    HRESULT result = CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentWithOptions(
+        nullptr, cache.c_str(), nullptr,
+        Callback<ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentCompletedHandler>(
+            [](HRESULT result, ICoreWebView2Environment *env) -> HRESULT {
+              if (host->closing)
+                return S_OK;
+              if (FAILED(result) || !env) {
+                MessageBoxW(host->window,
+                            L"Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is missing or "
+                            L"unavailable. Run SimplyPrint Setup again to "
+                            L"install or repair it.",
+                            L"SimplyPrint @ SoC", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
+                DestroyWindow(host->window);
+                return S_OK;
+              }
+              host->environment = env;
+              try {
+                setupWebView();
+              } catch (...) {
+                DestroyWindow(host->window);
+              }
+              return S_OK;
+            })
+            .Get());
+    if (FAILED(result)) {
+      MessageBoxW(host->window,
+                  L"Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is unavailable. Run "
+                  L"SimplyPrint Setup again to install it.",
+                  L"SimplyPrint @ SoC", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
+      DestroyWindow(host->window);
+    }
+    MSG msg{};
+    while (GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) {
+      TranslateMessage(&msg);
+      DispatchMessageW(&msg);
+    }
+    host->closing = true;
+    host->stopWorker();
+    if (host->controller)
+      host->controller->Close();
+    host->view.Reset();
+    host->controller.Reset();
+    host->environment.Reset();
+    while (PeekMessageW(&msg, nullptr, responseMessage, responseMessage,
+                        PM_REMOVE))
+      delete reinterpret_cast<std::wstring *>(msg.lParam);
+    winrt::uninit_apartment();
+    return host->smoke && !host->smokeSucceeded ? 1 : 0;
+  } catch (...) {
+    if (host) {
+      host->closing = true;
+      host->stopWorker();
+    }
+    MessageBoxW(nullptr,
+                L"SimplyPrint @ SoC could not start. Reinstall the app or "
+                L"review the Windows setup guide.",
+                L"SimplyPrint @ SoC", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
+    return 1;
+  }
+}
+extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) void __stdcall sp_respond(const char *raw) {
+  if (sp::host && !sp::host->closing && raw) {
+    try {
+      sp::host->send(sp::json::parse(raw));
+    } catch (...) {
+    }
+  }
+}
