+#pragma once
+#include <algorithm>
+#include <cmath>
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
+#include <regex>
+#include <set>
+#include <stdexcept>
+#include <string>
+#include <vector>
+
+namespace sp {
+using json = nlohmann::json;
+inline bool trustedDocument(const std::wstring &url) {
+  return url == L"https://socprint.invalid/index.html";
+}
+inline void require(bool ok, const char *message) {
+  if (!ok)
+    throw std::runtime_error(message);
+}
+inline std::vector<int> pages(const std::string &range, int count) {
+  require(count > 0 && count <= 100000,
+          "Choose a PDF containing 1 to 100,000 pages.");
+  require(range.size() <= 16384, "The page selection is too long.");
+  std::vector<int> out;
+  if (range.empty()) {
+    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
+      out.push_back(i);
+    return out;
+  }
+  std::regex item(R"(^\s*([0-9]+)(?:\s*-\s*([0-9]+))?\s*$)");
+  size_t start = 0;
+  do {
+    auto end = range.find(',', start);
+    auto token =
+        range.substr(start, end == std::string::npos ? end : end - start);
+    std::smatch m;
+    require(std::regex_match(token, m, item),
+            "Enter page numbers like 1-3, 5.");
+    auto first = std::stoull(m[1].str()),
+         last = m[2].matched ? std::stoull(m[2].str()) : first;
+    require(first >= 1 && last >= first &&
+                last <= static_cast<unsigned>(count) &&
+                out.size() + last - first + 1 <= 100000,
+            "The page selection is outside this document or too large.");
+    for (auto p = first; p <= last; ++p)
+      out.push_back(static_cast<int>(p - 1));
+    if (end == std::string::npos)
+      break;
+    start = end + 1;
+  } while (true);
+  return out;
+}
+inline void options(const json &o) {
+  require(o.is_object() && o.size() == 8, "Check the print settings.");
+  for (auto k : {"Paper", "Orientation", "ScaleMode", "PageRange"})
+    require(o.contains(k) && o[k].is_string(), "Check the print settings.");
+  for (auto k : {"Copies", "PagesPerSheet"})
+    require(o.contains(k) && o[k].is_number_integer(),
+            "Check numeric print settings.");
+  require(o.contains("ScalePercent") && o["ScalePercent"].is_number() &&
+              o.contains("AutoRotate") && o["AutoRotate"].is_boolean(),
+          "Check numeric print settings.");
+  require(o["Paper"] == "A4" || o["Paper"] == "A3", "Unsupported paper.");
+  require(o["Orientation"] == "portrait" || o["Orientation"] == "landscape",
+          "Unsupported orientation.");
+  require(o["ScaleMode"] == "fit" || o["ScaleMode"] == "fill" ||
+              o["ScaleMode"] == "percent",
+          "Unsupported scaling.");
+  require(o["Copies"] >= 1 && o["Copies"] <= 99, "Check copies.");
+  require(o["PagesPerSheet"] == 1 || o["PagesPerSheet"] == 2 ||
+              o["PagesPerSheet"] == 4 || o["PagesPerSheet"] == 6 ||
+              o["PagesPerSheet"] == 9 || o["PagesPerSheet"] == 16,
+          "Check layout.");
+  double scale = o["ScalePercent"].get<double>();
+  int copies = o["Copies"].get<int>(), n = o["PagesPerSheet"].get<int>();
+  require(copies >= 1 && copies <= 99 && std::isfinite(scale) && scale >= 1 &&
+              scale <= 400 && std::set<int>{1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 16}.count(n),
+          "Check copies, scaling and layout.");
+  require(o["PageRange"].get<std::string>().size() <= 16384,
+          "The page selection is too long.");
+}
+inline void request(const json &b) {
+  require(b.is_object() && b.contains("ID") && b["ID"].is_string() &&
+              b["ID"].get<std::string>().size() <= 80 && b.contains("Action") &&
+              b["Action"].is_string(),
+          "Invalid request.");
+  static const std::set<std::string> strings = {"ID",
+                                                "Action",
+                                                "Username",
+                                                "Password",
+                                                "KeyPath",
+                                                "KeyPassphrase",
+                                                "Passphrase",
+                                                "AdditionalPublicKeys",
+                                                "DocumentHandle",
+                                                "PreparedHandle",
+                                                "Handle",
+                                                "PrinterID",
+                                                "Queue",
+                                                "JobID",
+                                                "TermsVersion",
+                                                "Secret",
+                                                "Title",
+                                                "Message",
+                                                "Style",
+                                                "Status",
+                                                "Text",
+                                                "URL"};
+  static const std::set<std::string> actions = {"initialize",
+                                                "acceptTerms",
+                                                "detectNetwork",
+                                                "checkJumpKey",
+                                                "enrollJumpKey",
+                                                "createAndEnrollKey",
+                                                "saveCredentials",
+                                                "signIn",
+                                                "trustHost",
+                                                "cancelTrust",
+                                                "createKey",
+                                                "getPublicKey",
+                                                "useKey",
+                                                "submitPrint",
+                                                "listJobs",
+                                                "refreshJobs",
+                                                "queue",
+                                                "cancelJob",
+                                                "signOut",
+                                                "shutdown",
+                                                "choosePDF",
+                                                "chooseKey",
+                                                "previewPDF",
+                                                "preparePDF",
+                                                "releaseDocument",
+                                                "nativeAlert",
+                                                "showJumpSetupNotification",
+                                                "clearJumpSetupNotification",
+                                                "revealSecret",
+                                                "quitApp",
+                                                "copyText",
+                                                "openURL"};
+  require(actions.count(b["Action"].get<std::string>()) != 0,
+          "That action is not available.");
+  for (auto it = b.begin(); it != b.end(); ++it) {
+    auto k = it.key();
+    auto &v = it.value();
+    if (strings.count(k))
+      require(v.is_string() && v.get<std::string>().size() <= 16384,
+              "Invalid text field.");
+    else if (k == "Forget" || k == "ClearKey" || k == "Retrieve")
+      require(v.is_boolean(), "Invalid boolean field.");
+    else if (k == "Options")
+      options(v);
+    else if (k == "Sheet")
+      require(v.is_number_integer() && v.get<int64_t>() >= 0 &&
+                  v.get<int64_t>() <= 100000,
+              "Invalid preview sheet.");
+    else if (k == "Buttons" || k == "ExpectedFingerprints") {
+      require(v.is_array() &&
+                  v.size() <= static_cast<size_t>(k == "Buttons" ? 3 : 200),
+              "Invalid list.");
+      for (auto &x : v)
+        require(x.is_string() && x.get<std::string>().size() <= 100,
+                "Invalid list item.");
+    } else
+      throw std::runtime_error(
+          "Unsupported field. Raw file paths are not a web API.");
+  }
+  auto action = b["Action"].get<std::string>();
+  if (action == "previewPDF" || action == "preparePDF") {
+    require(b.contains("DocumentHandle") &&
+                !b["DocumentHandle"].get<std::string>().empty() &&
+                b.contains("Options"),
+            "Choose a PDF first.");
+    if (action == "previewPDF")
+      require(b.contains("Sheet"), "Choose a preview sheet.");
+    else
+      require(b.contains("Username") && b.contains("PrinterID") &&
+                  b.contains("Queue") &&
+                  !b["PrinterID"].get<std::string>().empty() &&
+                  !b["Queue"].get<std::string>().empty(),
+              "Choose an account, printer and queue.");
+  }
+  if (action == "submitPrint")
+    require(b.size() == 3 && b.contains("PreparedHandle") &&
+                !b["PreparedHandle"].get<std::string>().empty(),
+            "Prepare the PDF before printing.");
+  if (action == "releaseDocument")
+    require(b.contains("Handle") && !b["Handle"].get<std::string>().empty(),
+            "Unknown document handle.");
+}
+struct Cell {
+  double x, y, w, h;
+};
+struct Layout {
+  double width, height;
+  int columns, rows;
+  std::vector<Cell> cells;
+};
+inline Layout layout(const json &o) {
+  options(o);
+  bool a3 = o["Paper"] == "A3";
+  Layout l{a3 ? 841.8898 : 595.2756, a3 ? 1190.5512 : 841.8898, 1, 1, {}};
+  if (o["Orientation"] == "landscape")
+    std::swap(l.width, l.height);
+  int n = o["PagesPerSheet"].get<int>();
+  l.columns = n == 6 || n == 4 ? 2 : n == 9 ? 3 : n == 16 ? 4 : 1;
+  if (n == 2 && l.width > l.height)
+    l.columns = 2;
+  l.rows = (n + l.columns - 1) / l.columns;
+  double gap = n == 1 ? 0 : 12,
+         w = (l.width - 36 - (l.columns - 1) * gap) / l.columns,
+         h = (l.height - 36 - (l.rows - 1) * gap) / l.rows;
+  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
+    l.cells.push_back({18 + (i % l.columns) * (w + gap),
+                       l.height - 18 - h - (i / l.columns) * (h + gap), w, h});
+  return l;
+}
+inline json success(const json &b, json data = json::object()) {
+  return {{"ID", b.value("ID", std::string())},
+          {"OK", true},
+          {"Data", std::move(data)}};
+}
+inline json failure(const json &b, const std::string &code,
+                    const std::string &error) {
+  return {{"ID", b.is_object() && b.contains("ID") && b["ID"].is_string()
+                     ? b["ID"].get<std::string>()
+                     : ""},
+          {"OK", false},
+          {"Code", code},
+          {"Error", error}};
+}
+} // namespace sp

+#include "pdf.h"

+namespace sp {
+using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;
+namespace fs = std::filesystem;
+std::wstring wide(const std::string &s) {
+  if (s.empty())
+    return {};
+  int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, s.data(),
+                              static_cast<int>(s.size()), nullptr, 0);
+  require(n > 0, "Invalid UTF-8 text.");
+  std::wstring out(n, 0);
+  MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, s.data(),
+                      static_cast<int>(s.size()), out.data(), n);
+  return out;
+}
+std::string utf8(const std::wstring &s) {
+  if (s.empty())
+    return {};
+  int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, s.data(),
+                              static_cast<int>(s.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr,
+                              nullptr);
+  require(n > 0, "Invalid Windows path.");
+  std::string out(n, 0);
+  WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, s.data(),
+                      static_cast<int>(s.size()), out.data(), n, nullptr,
+                      nullptr);
+  return out;
+}
+struct Handle {
+  HANDLE h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
+  explicit Handle(HANDLE x) : h(x) {}
+  ~Handle() {
+    if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
+      CloseHandle(h);
+  }
+  operator HANDLE() const { return h; }
+};
+struct Doc {
+  FPDF_DOCUMENT p = nullptr;
+  explicit Doc(FPDF_DOCUMENT x) : p(x) {}
+  ~Doc() {
+    if (p)
+      FPDF_CloseDocument(p);
+  }
+  operator FPDF_DOCUMENT() const { return p; }
+  FPDF_DOCUMENT take() {
+    auto x = p;
+    p = nullptr;
+    return x;
+  }
+};
+struct Page {
+  FPDF_PAGE p = nullptr;
+  explicit Page(FPDF_PAGE x) : p(x) {}
+  ~Page() {
+    if (p)
+      FPDF_ClosePage(p);
+  }
+  operator FPDF_PAGE() const { return p; }
+};
+struct Object {
+  FPDF_PAGEOBJECT p = nullptr;
+  explicit Object(FPDF_PAGEOBJECT x) : p(x) {}
+  ~Object() {
+    if (p)
+      FPDFPageObj_Destroy(p);
+  }
+  FPDF_PAGEOBJECT take() {
+    auto x = p;
+    p = nullptr;
+    return x;
+  }
+};
+struct XObject {
+  FPDF_XOBJECT p = nullptr;
+  explicit XObject(FPDF_XOBJECT x) : p(x) {}
+  ~XObject() {
+    if (p)
+      FPDF_CloseXObject(p);
+  }
+  operator FPDF_XOBJECT() const { return p; }
+};
+void protect(const fs::path &path) {
+  Handle file(CreateFileW(
+      path.c_str(), READ_CONTROL | WRITE_DAC | FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES,
+      FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr,
+      OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS | FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT,
+      nullptr));
+  require(file.h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, "Could not open private storage.");
+  BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info{};
+  require(GetFileInformationByHandle(file, &info) &&
+              !(info.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT),
+          "Private storage cannot use reparse points.");
+  HANDLE tokenRaw;
+  require(OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &tokenRaw) != 0,
+          "Could not identify this Windows account.");
+  Handle token(tokenRaw);
+  DWORD count = 0;
+  GetTokenInformation(token, TokenUser, nullptr, 0, &count);
+  std::vector<BYTE> data(count);
+  require(GetTokenInformation(token, TokenUser, data.data(), count, &count) !=
+              0,
+          "Could not identify this Windows account.");
+  LPWSTR sid = nullptr;
+  require(ConvertSidToStringSidW(
+              reinterpret_cast<TOKEN_USER *>(data.data())->User.Sid, &sid) != 0,
+          "Could not identify this Windows account.");
+  std::wstring sddl =
+      L"D:P(A;OICI;FA;;;SY)(A;OICI;FA;;;" + std::wstring(sid) + L")";
+  LocalFree(sid);
+  PSECURITY_DESCRIPTOR sd = nullptr;
+  require(ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW(
+              sddl.c_str(), SDDL_REVISION_1, &sd, nullptr) != 0,
+          "Could not protect private storage.");
+  PACL acl = nullptr;
+  BOOL present = FALSE, def = FALSE;
+  BOOL got = GetSecurityDescriptorDacl(sd, &present, &acl, &def);
+  DWORD result = got ? SetSecurityInfo(file, SE_FILE_OBJECT,
+                                       DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION |
+                                           PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
+                                       nullptr, nullptr, acl, nullptr)
+                     : ERROR_INVALID_DATA;
+  LocalFree(sd);
+  require(result == ERROR_SUCCESS, "Could not protect private storage.");
+}
+std::string randomID() {
+  unsigned char bytes[16];
+  require(BCryptGenRandom(nullptr, bytes, sizeof(bytes),
+                          BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG) == 0,
+          "Could not generate a document handle.");
+  std::string id;
+  for (auto c : bytes) {
+    id += "0123456789abcdef"[c >> 4];
+    id += "0123456789abcdef"[c & 15];
+  }
+  return id;
+}
+PDFController::PDFController(const fs::path &root) {
+  fs::create_directories(root);
+  protect(root);
+  for (auto &e : fs::directory_iterator(root)) {
+    if (e.path().filename().wstring().rfind(L"session-", 0) != 0 ||
+        !e.is_directory() || e.is_symlink())
+      continue;
+    auto attr = GetFileAttributesW(e.path().c_str());
+    if (attr == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES || attr & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT)
+      continue;
+    Handle probe(CreateFileW(
+        (e.path() / L"owner.lock").c_str(), GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, 0,
+        nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, nullptr));
+    if (probe.h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
+      CloseHandle(probe.h);
+      probe.h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
+      std::error_code ec;
+      fs::remove_all(e.path(), ec);
+    }
+  }
+  directory = root / (L"session-" + wide(randomID()));
+  require(fs::create_directory(directory),
+          "Could not create private document storage.");
+  protect(directory);
+  owner = CreateFileW((directory / L"owner.lock").c_str(),
+                      GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE,
+                      FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
+                      nullptr, CREATE_NEW, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN, nullptr);
+  require(owner != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE,
+          "Could not lock private document storage.");
+  static struct Library {
+    Library() {
+      FPDF_LIBRARY_CONFIG config{};
+      config.version = 2;
+      FPDF_InitLibraryWithConfig(&config);
+    }
+    ~Library() { FPDF_DestroyLibrary(); }
+  } library;
+}
+PDFController::~PDFController() {
+  for (auto &[id, d] : documents)
+    if (d.pdf)
+      FPDF_CloseDocument(d.pdf);
+  documents.clear();
+  prepared.clear();
+  if (owner != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
+    CloseHandle(owner);
+  std::error_code ec;
+  fs::remove_all(directory, ec);
+}
+json PDFController::open(const fs::path &source) {
+  require(documents.size() < 4,
+          "Close the previous document before choosing another PDF.");
+  Handle input(CreateFileW(
+      source.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
+      FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT | FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, nullptr));
+  BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION before{};
+  require(input.h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE &&
+              GetFileType(input) == FILE_TYPE_DISK &&
+              GetFileInformationByHandle(input, &before) &&
+              !(before.dwFileAttributes &
+                (FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT | FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY)),
+          "Choose a readable regular PDF.");
+  uint64_t size = (uint64_t(before.nFileSizeHigh) << 32) | before.nFileSizeLow;
+  require(size >= 5 && size <= 1000000000, "Choose a PDF no larger than 1 GB.");
+  auto id = randomID();
+  auto path = directory / (wide(id) + L"-source.pdf");
+  try {
+    {
+      Handle output(
+          CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE,
+                      FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
+                      nullptr, CREATE_NEW, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
+      require(output.h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, "Could not snapshot the PDF.");
+      protect(path);
+      char buffer[65536];
+      uint64_t total = 0;
+      DWORD got = 0, written = 0;
+      char magic[5]{};
+      while (true) {
+        require(ReadFile(input, buffer, sizeof(buffer), &got, nullptr) != 0,
+                "Could not read the PDF.");
+        if (!got)
+          break;
+        if (total == 0) {
+          require(got >= 5, "This PDF is empty.");
+          memcpy(magic, buffer, 5);
+        }
+        total += got;
+        require(total <= 1000000000 &&
+                    WriteFile(output, buffer, got, &written, nullptr) &&
+                    written == got,
+                "Could not snapshot the PDF.");
+      }
+      BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION after{};
+      require(
+          total == size && memcmp(magic, "%PDF-", 5) == 0 &&
+              GetFileInformationByHandle(input, &after) &&
+              before.nFileSizeHigh == after.nFileSizeHigh &&
+              before.nFileSizeLow == after.nFileSizeLow &&
+              CompareFileTime(&before.ftLastWriteTime,
+                              &after.ftLastWriteTime) == 0 &&
+              FlushFileBuffers(output),
+          "The PDF changed or could not be copied safely. Choose it again.");
+    }
+    // PDFium's path API accepts UTF-8; keep the protected snapshot filename
+    // ASCII.
+    Doc doc(FPDF_LoadDocument(utf8(path.wstring()).c_str(), nullptr));
+    require(doc.p != nullptr, "This PDF is locked or damaged.");
+    int count = FPDF_GetPageCount(doc);
+    require(count > 0 && count <= 100000,
+            "This PDF is empty or has too many pages.");
+    auto name = utf8(source.filename().wstring());
+    documents.emplace(id, Document{path, name, doc.take()});
+    return {{"DocumentHandle", id},
+            {"FileName", name},
+            {"Size", size},
+            {"PageCount", count}};
+  } catch (...) {
+    std::error_code ec;
+    fs::remove(path, ec);
+    throw;
+  }
+}
+FPDF_DOCUMENT PDFController::compose(Document &source, const json &o,
+                                     const std::vector<int> &indexes, int first,
+                                     int end) {
+  auto grid = layout(o);
+  int n = o["PagesPerSheet"].get<int>();
+  Doc output(FPDF_CreateNewDocument());
+  require(output.p != nullptr, "Could not create an output PDF.");
+  auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(120);
+  for (int sheet = first; sheet < end; ++sheet) {
+    require(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline,
+            "The PDF preparation time limit was exceeded.");
+    Page dest(FPDFPage_New(output, sheet - first, grid.width, grid.height));
+    require(dest.p != nullptr, "Could not create an output sheet.");
+    for (int slot = 0;
+         slot < n && sheet * n + slot < static_cast<int>(indexes.size());
+         ++slot) {
+      int index = indexes[sheet * n + slot];
+      Page page(FPDF_LoadPage(source.pdf, index));
+      require(page.p != nullptr, "A selected PDF page is unreadable.");
+      require(FPDFPage_Flatten(page, FLAT_PRINT) != FLATTEN_FAIL,
+              "The PDF's printable annotations could not be prepared.");
+      double pw = FPDF_GetPageWidthF(page), ph = FPDF_GetPageHeightF(page);
+      require(pw > 0 && ph > 0 && std::isfinite(pw) && std::isfinite(ph),
+              "The PDF has invalid page dimensions.");
+      auto cell = grid.cells[slot];
+      bool rotate =
+          o["AutoRotate"].get<bool>() && ((pw > ph) != (cell.w > cell.h));
+      double rw = rotate ? ph : pw, rh = rotate ? pw : ph;
+      double factor =
+          o["ScaleMode"] == "percent" ? o["ScalePercent"].get<double>() / 100
+          : o["ScaleMode"] == "fill"  ? std::max(cell.w / rw, cell.h / rh)
+                                      : std::min(cell.w / rw, cell.h / rh);
+      // The intermediate page's bounding box clips each slot, including fill
+      // and custom scaling. PDFium's imported XObject normalizes crop box and
+      // rotation.
+      Doc tile(FPDF_CreateNewDocument());
+      require(tile.p != nullptr, "Could not create a PDF slot.");
+      Page tilePage(FPDFPage_New(tile, 0, cell.w, cell.h));
+      require(tilePage.p != nullptr, "Could not create a PDF slot.");
+      XObject src(FPDF_NewXObjectFromPage(tile, source.pdf, index));
+      require(src.p != nullptr, "Could not import a PDF page.");
+      Object obj(FPDF_NewFormObjectFromXObject(src));
+      require(obj.p != nullptr, "Could not import PDF content.");
+      if (rotate)
+        FPDFPageObj_Transform(obj.p, 0, factor, -factor, 0,
+                              (cell.w + ph * factor) / 2,
+                              (cell.h - pw * factor) / 2);
+      else
+        FPDFPageObj_Transform(obj.p, factor, 0, 0, factor,
+                              (cell.w - pw * factor) / 2,
+                              (cell.h - ph * factor) / 2);
+      FPDFPage_InsertObject(tilePage, obj.take());
+      require(FPDFPage_GenerateContent(tilePage) != 0,
+              "Could not compose the PDF slot.");
+      XObject placed(FPDF_NewXObjectFromPage(output, tile, 0));
+      require(placed.p != nullptr, "Could not compose the output sheet.");
+      Object placement(FPDF_NewFormObjectFromXObject(placed));
+      require(placement.p != nullptr, "Could not compose the output sheet.");
+      FPDFPageObj_Transform(placement.p, 1, 0, 0, 1, cell.x, cell.y);
+      FPDFPage_InsertObject(dest, placement.take());
+    }
+    require(FPDFPage_GenerateContent(dest) != 0,
+            "Could not finish the output sheet.");
+  }
+  return output.take();
+}
+std::string renderPreview(FPDF_PAGE page) {
+  int height = 720,
+      width = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(FPDF_GetPageWidthF(page) * height /
+                                         FPDF_GetPageHeightF(page)));
+  require(width > 0 && width <= 2048, "Invalid preview dimensions.");
+  FPDF_BITMAP bitmap = FPDFBitmap_Create(width, height, 1);
+  require(bitmap != nullptr, "Could not create the preview.");
+  struct Cleanup {
+    FPDF_BITMAP p;
+    ~Cleanup() { FPDFBitmap_Destroy(p); }
+  } cleanup{bitmap};
+  FPDFBitmap_FillRect(bitmap, 0, 0, width, height, 0xffffffff);
+  FPDF_RenderPageBitmap(bitmap, page, 0, 0, width, height, 0, FPDF_PRINTING);
+  ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> factory;
+  require(
+      SUCCEEDED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr,
+                                 CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory))),
+      "Could not encode the preview.");
+  ComPtr<IStream> stream;
+  require(SUCCEEDED(CreateStreamOnHGlobal(nullptr, TRUE, &stream)),
+          "Could not encode the preview.");
+  ComPtr<IWICBitmapEncoder> encoder;
+  require(
+      SUCCEEDED(
+          factory->CreateEncoder(GUID_ContainerFormatPng, nullptr, &encoder)) &&
+          SUCCEEDED(encoder->Initialize(stream.Get(), WICBitmapEncoderNoCache)),
+      "Could not encode the preview.");
+  ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameEncode> frame;
+  ComPtr<IPropertyBag2> properties;
+  require(SUCCEEDED(encoder->CreateNewFrame(&frame, &properties)) &&
+              SUCCEEDED(frame->Initialize(properties.Get())) &&
+              SUCCEEDED(frame->SetSize(width, height)),
+          "Could not encode the preview.");
+  WICPixelFormatGUID format = GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA;
+  require(SUCCEEDED(frame->SetPixelFormat(&format)) &&
+              IsEqualGUID(format, GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA),
+          "Unsupported preview format.");
+  int stride = FPDFBitmap_GetStride(bitmap);
+  require(SUCCEEDED(frame->WritePixels(
+              height, stride, stride * height,
+              static_cast<BYTE *>(FPDFBitmap_GetBuffer(bitmap)))) &&
+              SUCCEEDED(frame->Commit()) && SUCCEEDED(encoder->Commit()),
+          "Could not finish the preview.");
+  STATSTG stat{};
+  require(SUCCEEDED(stream->Stat(&stat, STATFLAG_NONAME)) &&
+              stat.cbSize.QuadPart <= 8 * 1024 * 1024,
+          "The preview is too large.");
+  LARGE_INTEGER zero{};
+  stream->Seek(zero, STREAM_SEEK_SET, nullptr);
+  std::vector<BYTE> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(stat.cbSize.QuadPart));
+  ULONG read = 0;
+  require(SUCCEEDED(stream->Read(bytes.data(), static_cast<ULONG>(bytes.size()),
+                                 &read)) &&
+              read == bytes.size(),
+          "Could not read the preview.");
+  DWORD length = 0;
+  require(CryptBinaryToStringA(bytes.data(), read,
+                               CRYPT_STRING_BASE64 | CRYPT_STRING_NOCRLF,
+                               nullptr, &length) != 0,
+          "Could not encode the preview.");
+  std::string result(length, 0);
+  require(CryptBinaryToStringA(bytes.data(), read,
+                               CRYPT_STRING_BASE64 | CRYPT_STRING_NOCRLF,
+                               result.data(), &length) != 0,
+          "Could not encode the preview.");
+  result.resize(length);
+  return "data:image/png;base64," + result;
+}
+json PDFController::preview(const json &b) {
+  auto it = documents.find(b.at("DocumentHandle").get<std::string>());
+  require(it != documents.end(),
+          "This document is no longer open. Choose it again.");
+  auto &o = b.at("Options");
+  options(o);
+  auto indexes = pages(o["PageRange"], FPDF_GetPageCount(it->second.pdf));
+  int n = o["PagesPerSheet"],
+      count = (static_cast<int>(indexes.size()) + n - 1) / n,
+      sheet = b.at("Sheet");
+  require(sheet >= 0 && sheet < count, "That preview sheet does not exist.");
+  Doc output(compose(it->second, o, indexes, sheet, sheet + 1));
+  Page page(FPDF_LoadPage(output, 0));
+  require(page.p != nullptr, "Could not load the preview.");
+  std::vector<int> selected(
+      indexes.begin() + sheet * n,
+      indexes.begin() +
+          std::min((sheet + 1) * n, static_cast<int>(indexes.size())));
+  return {{"Image", renderPreview(page)},
+          {"Sheet", sheet},
+          {"SheetCount", count},
+          {"Pages", selected}};
+}
+struct Writer : FPDF_FILEWRITE {
+  HANDLE file;
+  uint64_t count = 0;
+  std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point deadline =
+      std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(120);
+  explicit Writer(HANDLE h, std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point limit)
+      : file(h), deadline(limit) {
+    version = 1;
+    WriteBlock = [](FPDF_FILEWRITE *raw, const void *data,
+                    unsigned long size) -> int {
+      auto *self = static_cast<Writer *>(raw);
+      self->count += size;
+      if (self->count > 1000000000 ||
+          std::chrono::steady_clock::now() > self->deadline)
+        return 0;
+      DWORD written = 0;
+      return WriteFile(self->file, data, size, &written, nullptr) &&
+             written == size;
+    };
+  }
+};
+json PDFController::prepare(const json &b, uint64_t revision) {
+  auto it = documents.find(b.at("DocumentHandle").get<std::string>());
+  require(it != documents.end(),
+          "This document is no longer open. Choose it again.");
+  require(prepared.size() < 2, "Another document is already being prepared.");
+  auto &o = b.at("Options");
+  options(o);
+  auto indexes = pages(o["PageRange"], FPDF_GetPageCount(it->second.pdf));
+  int n = o["PagesPerSheet"],
+      count = (static_cast<int>(indexes.size()) + n - 1) / n;
+  auto id = randomID();
+  auto path = directory / (wide(id) + L".pdf");
+  auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(120);
+  try {
+    Doc output(compose(it->second, o, indexes, 0, count));
+    {
+      Handle file(
+          CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE,
+                      FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
+                      nullptr, CREATE_NEW, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
+      require(file.h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE,
+              "Could not create a protected output PDF.");
+      protect(path);
+      Writer writer(file, deadline);
+      require(FPDF_SaveAsCopy(output, &writer, FPDF_NO_INCREMENTAL) &&
+                  writer.count >= 5 && FlushFileBuffers(file),
+              "Could not save the PDF within its size or time limit.");
+    }
+    json metadata = {{"FilePath", utf8(path.wstring())},
+                     {"FileName", it->second.name},
+                     {"PrintSettings", o},
+                     {"PrinterID", b.at("PrinterID")},
+                     {"Queue", b.at("Queue")},
+                     {"Username", b.at("Username")},
+                     {"Copies", o["Copies"]},
+                     {"PageRange", o["PageRange"]}};
+    prepared.emplace(id, Prepared{path, metadata, revision, false});
+    return {{"PreparedHandle", id}, {"SheetCount", count}};
+  } catch (...) {
+    std::error_code ec;
+    fs::remove(path, ec);
+    throw;
+  }
+}
+json PDFController::consume(const json &b, uint64_t revision) {
+  auto it = prepared.find(b.at("PreparedHandle").get<std::string>());
+  require(
+      it != prepared.end() && !it->second.consumed,
+      "That print operation expired or was already sent. Prepare it again.");
+  require(it->second.revision == revision,
+          "The account changed. Review and prepare the PDF again.");
+  it->second.consumed = true;
+  auto out = it->second.metadata;
+  out["ID"] = b.at("ID");
+  out["Action"] = "submitPrint";
+  return out;
+}
+json PDFController::release(const std::string &id) {
+  auto p = prepared.find(id);
+  if (p != prepared.end()) {
+    require(fs::remove(p->second.path) || !fs::exists(p->second.path),
+            "The temporary PDF could not be removed.");
+    prepared.erase(p);
+  } else {
+    auto d = documents.find(id);
+    require(d != documents.end(), "Unknown document handle.");
+    FPDF_CloseDocument(d->second.pdf);
+    d->second.pdf = nullptr;
+    require(fs::remove(d->second.path) || !fs::exists(d->second.path),
+            "The source PDF could not be removed.");
+    documents.erase(d);
+  }
+  return {{"Released", true}};
+}
+} // namespace sp

index 0000000..2b4d7ee

+#pragma once
+#include "fpdfview.h"
+#include "model.h"
+#include <filesystem>
+#include <map>
+#include <windows.h>
+namespace sp {
+std::wstring wide(const std::string &value);
+std::string utf8(const std::wstring &value);
+void protect(const std::filesystem::path &path);
+std::string randomID();
+std::string renderPreview(FPDF_PAGE page);
+class PDFController {
+  struct Document {
+    std::filesystem::path path;
+    std::string name;
+    FPDF_DOCUMENT pdf = nullptr;
+  };
+  struct Prepared {
+    std::filesystem::path path;
+    json metadata;
+    uint64_t revision;
+    bool consumed = false;
+  };
+  std::filesystem::path directory;
+  HANDLE owner = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
+  std::map<std::string, Document> documents;
+  std::map<std::string, Prepared> prepared;
+  FPDF_DOCUMENT compose(Document &, const json &, const std::vector<int> &, int,
+                        int);
+
+public:
+  explicit PDFController(const std::filesystem::path &root);
+  ~PDFController();
+  json open(const std::filesystem::path &);
+  json preview(const json &);
+  json prepare(const json &, uint64_t revision);
+  json consume(const json &, uint64_t revision);
+  json release(const std::string &);
+  PDFController(const PDFController &) = delete;
+  PDFController &operator=(const PDFController &) = delete;
+};
+} // namespace sp
